"""Setup OWN PLAN-1 as a lane (``plan1``): the London 13:00-Thai opening-range break and the NY 08:30
straddle on every weekday (docs/PLAN1_LANE.md; research/2026-10-18-moments/agents/dev/plan1.py, the rules in
force in journal/PLAN1_JOURNAL.md / rules_week.py). Asia B2 is the third piece; it comes later (checkpoint B).

**London ORB** (:class:`Plan1Orb`, closed M1 bars; research ``d1_orb.decide`` + ``plan1.orb_trade``):

- the open ``t0`` = ``orb_open`` in ``orb_zone`` (13:00 Thai = 06:00 UTC); the day counts only when its first
  M1 bar at / after ``t0`` opens within ``late_open_minutes``;
- the range = the high / low of the M1 bars opening in [first bar, ``t0 + range_minutes``);
- skipped when the range is wider than ``wide_atr`` x the H1 ATR at ``t0`` (MT5 ATR(14): the simple average
  of 14 true ranges of H1 bars built from the M1 bars on the UTC hour, the last one complete by ``t0``);
- the entry = the **first** M1 close beyond the range among the bars opening in the ``entry_minutes``
  after it; decided at that bar's close; a buy at the ask, a sell at the bid;
- the stop = the range's other side, the target ``target_r`` x the risk (journal week 5: 1.5 R), out at the
  close of the M1 bar ``hold_minutes`` after the entry minute (:meth:`Plan1Orb.manage_position`).

**NY straddle** (:class:`Plan1Straddle`, quotes; research ``plan1.straddle``, S2's machinery): at 08:30:00
New York on every weekday a buy stop ``trigger_u`` USD above the last ask and a sell stop the same below the
last bid, live ``window_seconds``; the stop ``stop_u`` USD from the fill; no target (a far ``target_cap_u``
cap for the risk checks); out at 08:30 + ``hold_seconds``. 1 U = 1 USD here (the research's absolute USD).

``atr_floor`` (both pieces): None = no ATR gate (journal week 6 deleted the floor of 12); a number refuses the
trade below it. The H1 ATR is recorded either way.

**The journal record** (every entry's ``conditions``; owner 2026-10-21: "keep a trade journal"): the rule that
passed, the H1 ATR at the decision (last closed H1 bar), the opening range (ORB) or the trigger
(straddle), the pools at the entry (yesterday's server-day high / low, the Asia range 00:00-07:00 Thai,
today's server-day open; ``liq_journal.pools``), the stop distance, and the release on the calendar

ATHENS = ZoneInfo("Europe/Athens")  # FBS's server day: yesterday's high / low, today's open
BANGKOK = ZoneInfo("Asia/Bangkok")  # the Asia range 00:00-07:00 Thai
NEW_YORK = ZoneInfo("America/New_York")
ATR_BARS = 14
NS_MIN = 60 * 10**9
FloatArray = np.ndarray


def _zone(value: str) -> str:
    try:
        ZoneInfo(value)
    except (ZoneInfoNotFoundError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise ValueError(f"unknown time zone {value!r}") from exc
    return value


def _hhmm(value: str) -> str:
    hhmm(value)
    return value


def local_instant(day: date, at: str, zone: str) -> pd.Timestamp:
    """*at* (HH:MM) on the local *day* in *zone*, in UTC."""
    t = hhmm(at)
    return pd.Timestamp(
        datetime(day.year, day.month, day.day, t.hour, t.minute, tzinfo=ZoneInfo(zone))
    ).tz_convert("UTC")


# --- shared readings --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def h1_atr_at(
    opens: pd.DatetimeIndex, h: FloatArray, lo: FloatArray, c: FloatArray, t: pd.Timestamp
) -> float:
    """MT5 ATR(14) of the H1 bars built from M1 on the UTC hour, the last one complete by *t* (its hour + 1 h
    <= *t*); the true range against the previous H1 bar's close; NaN with fewer than 15 H1 bars."""
    hours = opens.floor("h")
    keep = np.asarray(hours + pd.Timedelta(hours=1) <= t)
    if not keep.any():
        return math.nan
    df = pd.DataFrame({"h": h[keep], "lo": lo[keep], "c": c[keep]}, index=hours[keep])
    g = df.groupby(level=0, sort=True)
    hh, ll, cc = g.h.max().to_numpy(float), g.lo.min().to_numpy(float), g.c.last().to_numpy(float)
    if len(cc) < ATR_BARS + 1:
        return math.nan
    pc = cc[-ATR_BARS - 1 : -1]
    tr = np.maximum(hh[-ATR_BARS:], pc) - np.minimum(ll[-ATR_BARS:], pc)
    return float(tr.mean())


def pools(
    opens: pd.DatetimeIndex, o: FloatArray, h: FloatArray, lo: FloatArray, t: pd.Timestamp
) -> dict[str, float]:
    """The pools known at *t* from M1 bars closed by *t* (liq_journal.pools): yesterday's server-day high /
    low (the last server day before today within three days), the Asia range (today's Thai 00:00-07:00, once
    Thai time is past 07:00), today's server-day open, and the last confirmed M15 3-bar fractal swing high /
    low (M15 bins of those M1 bars on the UTC quarter hour, the last 97, read from the second-last back)."""
    keep = np.asarray(opens + pd.Timedelta(minutes=1) <= t)
    idx = opens[keep]
    if not len(idx):
        return {}
    oo, hh, ll = o[keep], h[keep], lo[keep]
    srv = idx.tz_convert(ATHENS)
    srv_day = srv.normalize()
    today = srv_day[-1]
    out: dict[str, float] = {}
    before = np.asarray((srv_day < today) & (srv_day >= today - pd.Timedelta(days=3)))
    if before.any():
        yday = srv_day[before].max()
        y = np.asarray(srv_day == yday)
        out["yday_high"], out["yday_low"] = float(hh[y].max()), float(ll[y].min())
    thai = idx.tz_convert(BANGKOK)
    d0 = thai[-1].normalize()
    a = np.asarray((thai >= d0) & (thai < d0 + pd.Timedelta(hours=7)))
    if a.any() and t.tz_convert(BANGKOK) >= d0 + pd.Timedelta(hours=7):
        out["asia_high"], out["asia_low"] = float(hh[a].max()), float(ll[a].min())
    tod = np.flatnonzero(np.asarray(srv_day == today))
    out["today_open"] = float(oo[tod[0]])
    q = pd.DataFrame({"high": hh, "low": ll}, index=idx).resample("15min").agg({"high": "max", "low": "min"})
    q = q.dropna().iloc[-97:]
    qh, ql = q["high"].to_numpy(float), q["low"].to_numpy(float)
    for k in range(len(q) - 2, 0, -1):
        if "swing_high" not in out and qh[k] > qh[k - 1] and qh[k] > qh[k + 1]:
            out["swing_high"] = float(qh[k])
        if "swing_low" not in out and ql[k] < ql[k - 1] and ql[k] < ql[k + 1]:
            out["swing_low"] = float(ql[k])
        if "swing_high" in out and "swing_low" in out:
            break
    return out


def broken_pools(
    opens: pd.DatetimeIndex,
    o: FloatArray,
    h: FloatArray,
    lo: FloatArray,
    t: pd.Timestamp,
    side: int,
    found: dict[str, float],
    minutes: int = 15,
) -> list[str]:
    """The pools the M1 bars of the *minutes* before *t* (opening at / after t - minutes, closed by t) broke
    in the trade's direction (liq_journal's ``broke``): a buy - the window opened below the pool and traded
    above it; a sell mirrored."""
    keep = np.asarray((opens >= t - pd.Timedelta(minutes=minutes)) & (opens + pd.Timedelta(minutes=1) <= t))
    if not keep.any():
        return []
    first, top, bottom = float(o[keep][0]), float(h[keep].max()), float(lo[keep].min())
    if side > 0:
        return [k for k, v in found.items() if first < v < top]
    return [k for k, v in found.items() if first > v > bottom]


def is_contracting(change: float, max_pct: float) -> bool:
    """The H4 ATR's change (a fraction) at or below *max_pct* percent; unknown counts as contracting (fail
    closed)."""
    return not math.isfinite(change) or 100.0 * change <= max_pct


def h4_bars(
    opens: pd.DatetimeIndex, h: FloatArray, lo: FloatArray, c: FloatArray, t: pd.Timestamp
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """The broker's H4 bars (on the server day: 00:00, 04:00 .. Athens time) built from M1 bars, only those
    whose four hours are over by *t*, indexed by their close (UTC). A lane needs no H4 frame of its own: an H4
    frame's last bar is two days old on a Monday morning, which the decision engine refuses as stale."""
    local = opens.tz_convert(ATHENS).tz_localize(None).floor("4h")
    df = pd.DataFrame({"high": h, "low": lo, "close": c}, index=opens)
    g = df.groupby(local.as_unit("ns").to_numpy(dtype="datetime64[ns]"), sort=True)
    out = pd.DataFrame({"high": g.high.max(), "low": g.low.min(), "close": g.close.last()})
    closes = (pd.DatetimeIndex(out.index) + pd.Timedelta(hours=4)).tz_localize(ATHENS).tz_convert("UTC")
    out.index = closes
    return out[out.index <= t]


def d1_atr20(h1: pd.DataFrame | None, t: pd.Timestamp, n: int = 20) -> float:
    """MT5 ATR(n) of the broker's D1 bars (the server day, built from the H1 frame) known by *t*: a day is
    known from its server midnight (UTC) + 24 h on (journal/regime_switch.py); NaN with fewer than n days."""
    if h1 is None or not len(h1):
        return math.nan
    opens = pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(h1["open_time"], utc=True))
    day = opens.tz_convert(ATHENS).tz_localize(None).normalize()
    df = pd.DataFrame(
        {"h": h1["high"].to_numpy(float), "lo": h1["low"].to_numpy(float), "c": h1["close"].to_numpy(float)}
    )
    g = df.groupby(day.as_unit("ns").to_numpy(dtype="datetime64[ns]"), sort=True)
    d = pd.DataFrame({"h": g.h.max(), "lo": g.lo.min(), "c": g.c.last()})
    known = pd.DatetimeIndex(d.index).tz_localize(ATHENS).tz_convert("UTC") + pd.Timedelta(days=1)
    d = d[np.asarray(known <= t)]
    if len(d) < n:
        return math.nan
    hh, ll, cc = d.h.to_numpy(float), d.lo.to_numpy(float), d.c.to_numpy(float)
    pc = cc[-n - 1 : -1] if len(cc) > n else np.r_[np.nan, cc[-n:-1]]
    tr = np.fmax(hh[-n:], pc) - np.fmin(ll[-n:], pc)  # the first day without a previous close: high - low
    return float(tr.mean())


def regime(ctx: StrategyContext, t: pd.Timestamp, min_usd: float | None) -> Condition:
    """The regime switch (journal, CHECKLIST row 62): new entries only while the D1 ATR(20) >= *min_usd*; None
    = off. Unknown (too few closed days) = off for trading (fail closed)."""
    atr = d1_atr20(ctx.frames.get(Timeframe.H1), t)
    if min_usd is None:
        return Condition("regime", True, 1.0, f"D1 ATR(20) {atr:.2f}; the switch is off")
    ok = math.isfinite(atr) and atr >= min_usd
    return Condition(
        "regime",
        ok,
        1.0,
        f"D1 ATR(20) {atr:.2f} {'>=' if ok else '<'} {min_usd:g}: {'trade' if ok else 'no new entry'}",
    )


def h4_change_at(ctx: StrategyContext, t: pd.Timestamp, bars: int = 6) -> float:
    """The H4 ATR change at *t*: from the context's H4 frame when the lane has one, else from its M1 bars."""
    h4 = ctx.frames.get(Timeframe.H4)
    if h4 is None:
        m1 = ctx.frames.get(Timeframe.M1)
        if m1 is None or not len(m1):
            return math.nan
        opens, _, h, lo, c = _m1_arrays(m1)
        h4 = h4_bars(opens, h, lo, c, t)
    return h4_atr_change(h4, t, bars)


def h4_atr_change(h4: pd.DataFrame, t: pd.Timestamp, bars: int = 6) -> float:
    """The H4 ATR's change over the last ``bars`` H4 bars (6 = 24 h): MT5 ATR(14) of the H4 bars closed by
    *t* (the frame's index is the close time), the latest / the one ``bars`` earlier - 1; NaN when unknown."""
    done = h4[h4.index <= t]
    if len(done) < ATR_BARS + bars:
        return math.nan
    hh, ll, cc = (done[k].to_numpy(dtype=float) for k in ("high", "low", "close"))
    pc = np.r_[np.nan, cc[:-1]]
    tr = np.fmax(hh, pc) - np.fmin(ll, pc)  # the first bar: high - low (liq_journal's rolling max skips NaN)
    atr = pd.Series(tr).rolling(ATR_BARS).mean().to_numpy()
    now, then = float(atr[-1]), float(atr[-1 - bars])
    if not (math.isfinite(now) and math.isfinite(then)) or then <= 0:
        return math.nan
    return now / then - 1.0


def pools_detail(p: dict[str, float]) -> str:
    keys = ("yday_high", "yday_low", "asia_high", "asia_low", "today_open", "swing_high", "swing_low")
    return " ".join(f"{k}={p[k]:.2f}" if k in p else f"{k}=none" for k in keys)


def _m1_arrays(m1: pd.DataFrame) -> tuple[pd.DatetimeIndex, FloatArray, FloatArray, FloatArray, FloatArray]:
    opens = pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(m1["open_time"], utc=True))
    o, h, lo, c = (m1[k].to_numpy(dtype=float) for k in ("open", "high", "low", "close"))
    return opens, o, h, lo, c


# --- the London ORB ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


class Plan1OrbParams(StrategyParams):
    orb_open: str = "13:00"  # London 13:00 Thai = 06:00 UTC (Thailand keeps no summer time)
    orb_zone: str = "Asia/Bangkok"
    range_minutes: int = Field(default=15, ge=1, le=120)
    entry_minutes: int = Field(default=60, ge=1, le=240, description="the window after the range")
    late_open_minutes: int = Field(default=5, ge=0, le=60)
    wide_atr: float = Field(default=1.5, gt=0, le=20, description="skip a range wider than this x H1 ATR")
    target_r: float = Field(default=1.5, gt=0, le=20)  # journal week 5 (was 2 R)
    hold_minutes: int = Field(default=60, ge=1, le=1440)
    atr_floor: float | None = Field(default=None, gt=0, le=1000)  # journal week 6: no floor
    d1_atr20_min_usd: float | None = Field(
        default=60.0, gt=0, le=1000
    )  # the regime switch (row 62); None = off
    # journal week 10: when the H4 ATR(14) did not grow over the last ``h4_change_bars`` H4 bars (latest <=
    # that many bars earlier), enter only after the ``pool_break_minutes`` before the decision broke a pool in
    # the trade's direction
    pool_break_when_h4_contracting: bool = True
    h4_change_bars: int = Field(default=6, ge=1, le=60)
    pool_break_minutes: int = Field(default=15, ge=1, le=120)
    # "contracting" = the change in percent <= this; 0.5 is the journal's reading (liq_journal rounds the
    # change to a whole percent and rules_week takes <= 0: +0.4 % counts as contracting, +0.6 % does not)
    h4_contracting_max_pct: float = Field(default=0.5, ge=-50, le=50)

    @field_validator("orb_zone")
    @classmethod
    def _check_zone(cls, value: str) -> str:
        return _zone(value)

    @field_validator("orb_open")
    @classmethod
    def _check_open(cls, value: str) -> str:
        return _hhmm(value)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class OrbDecision:
    status: str  # late_open / no_range / wide / no_break / trade
    side: int = 0
    k: int = -1  # the decision bar (its close is the decision)
    rh: float = math.nan
    rl: float = math.nan
    h1_atr: float = math.nan  # the wide check's H1 ATR at the open


def orb_decide(
    opens: pd.DatetimeIndex,
    h: FloatArray,
    lo: FloatArray,
    c: FloatArray,
    t0: pd.Timestamp,
    atr: float,
    p: Plan1OrbParams,
) -> OrbDecision:
    """research d1_orb.decide on the bars given (all of them closed)."""
    ns = opens.as_unit("ns").to_numpy(dtype="datetime64[ns]").astype(np.int64)
    t0n = t0.as_unit("ns").value
    i0 = int(np.searchsorted(ns, t0n))
    if i0 >= len(ns) or ns[i0] - t0n > p.late_open_minutes * NS_MIN:
        return OrbDecision("late_open", h1_atr=atr)
    i_l = int(np.searchsorted(ns, t0n + p.range_minutes * NS_MIN))
    if i_l <= i0:
        return OrbDecision("no_range", h1_atr=atr)
    rh, rl = float(h[i0:i_l].max()), float(lo[i0:i_l].min())
    if not math.isfinite(atr) or rh - rl > p.wide_atr * atr:
        return OrbDecision("wide", rh=rh, rl=rl, h1_atr=atr)
    i_e = int(np.searchsorted(ns, t0n + (p.range_minutes + p.entry_minutes) * NS_MIN))
    for k in range(i_l, i_e):
        side = 1 if c[k] > rh else -1 if c[k] < rl else 0
        if side:
            return OrbDecision("trade", side, k, rh, rl, atr)
    return OrbDecision("no_break", rh=rh, rl=rl, h1_atr=atr)


class Plan1Orb(BaseStrategy):
    name = "setup_plan1_orb"
    version = "1.0.0"
    description = (
        "Setup OWN PLAN-1, London ORB: the first M1 close beyond the 13:00-Thai 15-minute range, the stop "
        "at its other side, 1.5 R, out after 60 minutes; M1 gold. Lane only. Unproven."
    )
    Params = Plan1OrbParams
    advised = False

    def required_timeframes(self) -> tuple[Timeframe, ...]:
        return (Timeframe.M1,)  # the H1 / H4 readings are built from M1

    def warmup_bars(self) -> int:
        return 3000  # 15 complete H1 bars and yesterday's server day across a weekend

    def window(self, at: pd.Timestamp) -> tuple[pd.Timestamp, pd.Timestamp, pd.Timestamp]:
        """The day's open and the first / last decision times (bar closes)."""
        p: Plan1OrbParams = self.params
        t0 = local_instant(at.tz_convert(p.orb_zone).date(), p.orb_open, p.orb_zone)
        return (
            t0,
            t0 + pd.Timedelta(minutes=p.range_minutes + 1),
            t0 + pd.Timedelta(minutes=p.range_minutes + p.entry_minutes),
        )

    def wants_bar(self, at: datetime) -> bool:
        t = pd.Timestamp(at)
        _, first, last = self.window(t)
        return first <= t <= last and t.weekday() <= 4

    def evaluate(self, ctx: StrategyContext) -> Signal:
        p: Plan1OrbParams = self.params
        market = ctx.market
        at = pd.Timestamp(market.decision_time_utc)
        if market.entry_timeframe is not Timeframe.M1:
            return self.hold(ctx, ReasonCode.DATA_QUALITY, explanation="the ORB runs on an M1 lane")
        t0, first, last = self.window(at)  # the first bar after the range closes at first
        if not first <= at <= last or at.weekday() > 4:
            return self.hold(ctx, ReasonCode.OUTSIDE_SESSION, explanation=f"{at:%a %H:%M} UTC")
        m1 = ctx.frame(Timeframe.M1)
        if len(m1) < 2:
            return self.hold(ctx, ReasonCode.INSUFFICIENT_DATA, explanation=f"{len(m1)} M1 bars")
        opens, o, h, lo, c = _m1_arrays(m1)
        atr0 = h1_atr_at(opens, h, lo, c, t0)
        d = orb_decide(opens, h, lo, c, t0, atr0, p)
        if d.status != "trade":
            return self.hold(ctx, ReasonCode.NO_SETUP, explanation=f"ORB {d.status}")
        if d.k != len(m1) - 1:
            return self.hold(
                ctx, ReasonCode.NO_SETUP, explanation=f"ORB broke at {opens[d.k]:%H:%M} UTC already"
            )
        buy = d.side > 0
        price = market.ask if buy else market.bid
        if price is None:
            return self.hold(ctx, ReasonCode.DATA_QUALITY, explanation="no quote")
        stop = d.rl if buy else d.rh
        risk = (price - stop) * d.side
        if not risk > 0:
            return self.hold(ctx, ReasonCode.NO_SETUP, explanation=f"the price {price:.2f} is past the stop")
        atr = h1_atr_at(opens, h, lo, c, at)
        floor_ok = p.atr_floor is None or (math.isfinite(atr) and atr >= p.atr_floor)
        found = pools(opens, o, h, lo, at)
        broke = broken_pools(opens, o, h, lo, at, d.side, found, p.pool_break_minutes)
        change = h4_change_at(ctx, at, p.h4_change_bars)
        contracting = is_contracting(change, p.h4_contracting_max_pct)
        pool_ok = not p.pool_break_when_h4_contracting or not contracting or bool(broke)
        h4_text = "unknown" if not math.isfinite(change) else f"{100 * change:+.1f} %"
        conds = [
            Condition(
                "rule",
                True,
                1.0,
                f"London ORB: the first M1 close {c[-1]:.2f} {'above' if buy else 'below'} the range "
                f"(bar {opens[d.k]:%H:%M} UTC)",
            ),
            Condition("h1_atr", floor_ok, 1.0, atr_detail(atr, p.atr_floor)),
            regime(ctx, at, p.d1_atr20_min_usd),
            Condition(
                "opening_range",
                True,
                1.0,
                f"{d.rl:.2f}-{d.rh:.2f} width {d.rh - d.rl:.2f} <= {p.wide_atr:g} x H1 ATR {atr0:.2f} at "
                f"{t0:%H:%M} UTC",
            ),
            Condition("pools", True, 1.0, pools_detail(found)),
            Condition(
                "h4_atr_change",
                True,
                1.0,
                f"H4 ATR(14) over {p.h4_change_bars} H4 bars {h4_text} "
                f"({'contracting' if contracting else 'expanding'})",
            ),
            Condition(
                "pool_break",
                pool_ok,
                1.0,
                f"the {p.pool_break_minutes} minutes broke: {','.join(broke) or 'none'}"
                + ("" if p.pool_break_when_h4_contracting else "; rule off"),
            ),
            Condition(
                "stop_distance",
                True,
                1.0,
                f"{risk:.2f} to the range {'low' if buy else 'high'} {stop:.2f}; target {p.target_r:g} R",
            ),
            Condition("spread", True, 1.0, spread_detail(market.bid, market.ask, ctx)),
        ]
        if not (floor_ok and pool_ok and conds[2].passed):
            return self.hold(ctx, ReasonCode.NO_SETUP, conditions=conds, explanation=explain(conds))
        return self.entry(
            ctx,
            Action.BUY if buy else Action.SELL,
            entry_price=price,
            stop_loss=stop,
            take_profit=price + d.side * p.target_r * risk,
            conditions=conds,
            score=60.0,
            explanation=explain(conds),
        )

    def manage_position(self, ctx: StrategyContext, pos: OpenPosition) -> PositionAdvice | None:
        """Out at the close of the M1 bar ``hold_minutes`` after the entry minute (research: the first tick at
        / after the fill + 60 minutes)."""
        p: Plan1OrbParams = self.params
        due = pd.Timestamp(pos.entry_time).floor("min") + pd.Timedelta(minutes=p.hold_minutes)
        if pd.Timestamp(ctx.decision_time_utc) >= due:
            return PositionAdvice(close=ExitReason.TIME_STOP, note=f"{p.hold_minutes} minutes")
        return None


def spread_detail(bid: float | None, ask: float | None, ctx: StrategyContext) -> str:
    """The decision quote's spread in USD and points (the journal's spread record)."""
    if bid is None or ask is None:
        return "no quote"
    point = None if ctx.spec is None else ctx.spec.point
    pts = "" if not point else f" ({(ask - bid) / point:.0f} points)"
    return f"{ask - bid:.2f}{pts} at the decision quote"


def atr_detail(atr: float, floor: float | None) -> str:
    base = f"H1 ATR {atr:.2f} (MT5 ATR(14), last closed H1 bar)"
    return base + ("; no floor" if floor is None else f"; floor {floor:g}")


# --- the NY straddle --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


class Plan1StraddleParams(StraddleParams):
    """S2's numbers in USD (1 U = 1 USD; ``unit_price`` is not used), on every weekday at ``ny_open``."""

    events: tuple[str, ...] = ("CPI", "NFP", "PPI", "PCE", "GDP")  # only named in the journal record
    ny_open: str = "08:30"
    ny_zone: str = "America/New_York"
    hold_seconds: float = Field(default=1800.0, gt=0, le=14_400)  # 30 minutes after 08:30
    target_cap_u: float = Field(default=100.0, gt=0, le=200)  # no target in the research: a far cap only
    atr_floor: float | None = Field(default=None, gt=0, le=1000)
    d1_atr20_min_usd: float | None = Field(
        default=60.0, gt=0, le=1000
    )  # the regime switch (row 62); None = off

    @field_validator("ny_zone")
    @classmethod
    def _check_zone(cls, value: str) -> str:
        return _zone(value)

    @field_validator("ny_open")
    @classmethod
    def _check_open(cls, value: str) -> str:
        return _hhmm(value)


def daily_release(day: date, p: Plan1StraddleParams) -> Release | None:
    """08:30 New York on a weekday *day*, as a release; None on a weekend."""
    if day.weekday() > 4:
        return None
    return Release(local_instant(day, p.ny_open, p.ny_zone).to_pydatetime(), "NY0830")


@dataclass
class DailyStraddle(ReleaseStraddle):
    """S2's planner with an instant on every weekday and the triggers / stop in USD."""

    def unit(self, bid: float) -> float:
        return 1.0

    def upcoming(self, at: datetime) -> Release | None:
        p = self.params
        if not isinstance(p, Plan1StraddleParams):
            raise TypeError("DailyStraddle needs Plan1StraddleParams")
        at = ensure_utc(at)
        r = daily_release(at.astimezone(ZoneInfo(p.ny_zone)).date(), p)
        if r is not None and r.at - timedelta(seconds=p.arm_seconds) <= at < r.at + timedelta(
            seconds=p.window_seconds
        ):
            return r
        return None


class Plan1Straddle(OwnS2):
    """The NY 08:30 straddle of PLAN-1 on every weekday: S2's quote path (the engine feeds quotes while
    :meth:`busy`), the triggers in USD, out at 08:30 + ``hold_seconds``."""

    name = "setup_plan1_ny"
    description = (
        "Setup OWN PLAN-1, NY straddle: at 08:30 New York every weekday a buy stop 2 USD above the ask and "
        "a sell stop 2 USD below the bid, the stop 8 USD, out after 30 minutes; gold, on quotes. Lane only. "
        "Unproven."
    )
    Params = Plan1StraddleParams
    advised = False

    def __init__(self, params: StrategyParams | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(params)
        self._calendar: tuple[Release, ...] = ()

    def attach_calendar(self, releases: Sequence[Release]) -> None:
        """The calendar only names the day's release in the journal; the straddle trades every weekday."""
        p: Plan1StraddleParams = self.params
        self._calendar = of_events(releases, p.events)
        self._planners.clear()

    def warmup_bars(self) -> int:
        return 3000

    def spans(self, start: datetime, end: datetime) -> list[tuple[datetime, datetime]]:
        p: Plan1StraddleParams = self.params
        arm, window = timedelta(seconds=p.arm_seconds + 5), timedelta(seconds=p.window_seconds)
        zone = ZoneInfo(p.ny_zone)
        day, last = (start - window).astimezone(zone).date(), (end + arm).astimezone(zone).date()
        out = []
        while day <= last:
            r = daily_release(day, p)
            if r is not None:
                out.append((r.at - arm, r.at + window))
            day += timedelta(days=1)
        return out

    def unit(self, bid: float) -> float:
        return 1.0

    def wants_bar(self, at: datetime) -> bool:
        return False  # it enters on quotes; its bars only manage its position

    def new_planner(self) -> ReleaseStraddle:
        return DailyStraddle(self.params, ())

    def release_on(self, at: datetime) -> str:
        names = sorted({r.event for r in self._calendar if r.at == at})
        return ",".join(names) if names else "none on the calendar"

    def entry_signal(self, ctx: StrategyContext, entry: StraddleEntry) -> Signal | None:
        """The market entry at the context's quote with the journal record; None without a quote or below an
        ``atr_floor`` (fail closed)."""
        p: Plan1StraddleParams = self.params
        market = ctx.market
        if market.bid is None or market.ask is None:
            return None
        at = pd.Timestamp(market.quote_time_utc or market.decision_time_utc)
        record = self.journal(ctx, entry, at)
        if record is None:
            return None
        conds, floor_ok = record
        if not floor_ok:
            return None
        buy = entry.side is Side.BUY
        sign = 1 if buy else -1
        price = market.ask if buy else market.bid
        return self.entry(
            ctx,
            Action.BUY if buy else Action.SELL,
            entry_price=price,
            stop_loss=price - sign * entry.stop_distance,
            take_profit=price + sign * p.target_cap_u,
            conditions=conds,
            score=60.0,
            explanation=f"NY 08:30 straddle: out at {entry.close_at:%H:%M:%S} UTC; " + explain(conds),
        )

    def journal(
        self, ctx: StrategyContext, entry: StraddleEntry, at: pd.Timestamp
    ) -> tuple[list[Condition], bool] | None:
        p: Plan1StraddleParams = self.params
        m1 = ctx.frames.get(Timeframe.M1)
        if m1 is None or not len(m1):
            return None
        opens, o, h, lo, c = _m1_arrays(m1)
        atr = h1_atr_at(opens, h, lo, c, at)
        floor_ok = p.atr_floor is None or (math.isfinite(atr) and atr >= p.atr_floor)
        buy = entry.side is Side.BUY
        conds = [
            Condition(
                "rule",
                True,
                1.0,
                f"NY straddle: the {'ask' if buy else 'bid'} crossed {entry.trigger:.2f} "
                f"({p.trigger_u:g} USD past the reference) at {at:%H:%M:%S} UTC",
            ),
            Condition("h1_atr", floor_ok, 1.0, atr_detail(atr, p.atr_floor)),
            regime(ctx, at, p.d1_atr20_min_usd),
            Condition(
                "release",
                True,
                1.0,
                f"{entry.release.at:%Y-%m-%d %H:%M} UTC: {self.release_on(entry.release.at)}",
            ),
            Condition("pools", True, 1.0, pools_detail(pools(opens, o, h, lo, at))),
            Condition("stop_distance", True, 1.0, f"{entry.stop_distance:.2f} from the fill; no target"),
            Condition("spread", True, 1.0, spread_detail(ctx.market.bid, ctx.market.ask, ctx)),
        ]
        return conds, floor_ok and conds[2].passed

    def manage_position(self, ctx: StrategyContext, pos: OpenPosition) -> PositionAdvice | None:
        """Out at the first bar close at / after 08:30 New York of the entry's day + ``hold_seconds``."""
        p: Plan1StraddleParams = self.params
        entry = pd.Timestamp(pos.entry_time)
        r = daily_release(entry.tz_convert(p.ny_zone).date(), p)
        start = pd.Timestamp(r.at) if r is not None else entry.floor("min")
        due = start + pd.Timedelta(seconds=p.hold_seconds)
        if pd.Timestamp(ctx.decision_time_utc) >= due:
            return PositionAdvice(close=ExitReason.TIME_STOP, note="the straddle's 30 minutes are over")
        return None


def journal_fields(signal: Signal) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """A signal's journal record as a flat dict (condition name -> detail), for reports."""
    return {c.name: c.detail for c in signal.conditions}
"""Setup OWN PLAN-1, Asia B2: a chart pattern at the owner's H1 level, confirmed by a pullback and a new
close, in the Asia window 07:00-09:00 Thai (docs/PLAN1_LANE.md; ported 1:1 from
research/2026-10-18-moments/agents/dev: patterns.py, p2_trades.py ``confirm_b`` / ``structure_exit_time``,
p3_trades.py setting ``B2``, p4_trades.py ``window_of``; precursors/zones.py ``levels_at``;
journal/rules_week.py's week-6 rule).

Per entry timeframe (M1: :class:`Plan1B2`, M5: :class:`Plan1B2M5` - two strategies so that a position's own
timeframe is known from its magic number after a restart), at the close of each of its bars:

1. **Swings:** a causal ATR ZigZag (a swing = 2 x the TF's MT5 ATR(14)) on the TF's bars built from M1.
2. **Patterns** breaking out at bar d (both sides, sells by the mirror): inverse H&S / H&S, W / M (and the one
   whose second low swept the first), the sweep then the higher low / lower high, a base then its break; no
   taller than 4 x ATR; the stop 0.2 ATR beyond the pattern's extreme.
3. **At a level:** the owner's H1 levels known at d's close (zones of 3+ or flipped H1 fractal swings, of 2
   swings, the five-day high / low, the previous server day's high / low, the latest swing top above / low
   below), the extreme within 0.1 H1 ATR of a level, or past it by at most 0.5 H1 ATR with the close back (a
   sweep; the sweep-turn needs it), or the base overlapping the zone; the nearest level wins.
4. **Confirmation (B):** after bar d, a pullback of 1 ATR from the post-breakout high, then the first close
   above that high, within 30 bars; none if a low reaches the extreme first. The entry is at that close,
   inside the Asia window; the candidate with the smallest risk (close to stop) wins.
5. **Week 6:** a second B2 trade of the Thai morning only in the first one's direction. The day's B2 entries
   are handed over by the engine from its stored decisions (:meth:`attach_entries`), so the rule survives a
   restart.
6. **Exits:** the target is the next level beyond the entry if it is more than one risk away (else only a far
   cap); the structure exit at the first TF bar closing beyond the last confirmed swing low (a buy) / high (a
   sell); out after 60 TF bars.

Every value comes from bars closed by the decision. The ZigZag starts at the window's start: on P1 / P2 its
structure equals the full-history one at every one of 600 sampled bars (dev/plan1_b2_parity.py).
"""

FloatArray = np.ndarray
NS_MIN = 60 * 10**9
ATHENS = ZoneInfo("Europe/Athens")

# patterns.py (frozen)
ZZ_K = 2.0
HEAD_ATR, SHOULDER_H, NECK_H = 0.5, 0.5, 0.5
EQ_ATR, EQ_H = 0.5, 0.15
SWEEP_W_H = 0.35
SPAN = {"ihs": 60, "w": 40, "st": 40}
BASE_MIN, BASE_MAX, BASE_W = 8, 40, 1.5

ZONE_H1, SWEEP_H1 = 0.1, 0.5
HEIGHT_ATR = 4.0
SELL_NAMES = {
    "W": "M",
    "W, the 2nd low swept the 1st": "M, the 2nd high swept the 1st",
    "inverse H&S": "H&S",

}

}

# --- bars, ATR, ZigZag --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Bars:
    t_open: np.ndarray  # int64 ns
    avail: np.ndarray  # int64 ns: when the bar is complete
    o: FloatArray
    h: FloatArray
    lo: FloatArray
    c: FloatArray


def tf_bars(
    opens: pd.DatetimeIndex,
    o: FloatArray,
    h: FloatArray,
    lo: FloatArray,
    c: FloatArray,
    minutes: int,
    t: pd.Timestamp,
) -> Bars:
    """patterns.tf_bars: bars of *minutes* from M1 on the clock (avail = open + minutes), only those
    complete by *t*."""
    if minutes == 1:
        key = opens
        df = pd.DataFrame({"o": o, "h": h, "lo": lo, "c": c}, index=opens)
    else:
        key = opens.floor(f"{minutes}min")
        g = pd.DataFrame({"o": o, "h": h, "lo": lo, "c": c}, index=opens).groupby(key, sort=True)
        df = pd.DataFrame({"o": g.o.first(), "h": g.h.max(), "lo": g.lo.min(), "c": g.c.last()})
    idx = pd.DatetimeIndex(df.index)
    t_open = idx.as_unit("ns").to_numpy(dtype="datetime64[ns]").astype(np.int64)
    avail = t_open + minutes * NS_MIN
    keep = avail <= pd.Timestamp(t).as_unit("ns").value
    return Bars(
        t_open[keep],
        avail[keep],
        df.o.to_numpy(float)[keep],
        df.h.to_numpy(float)[keep],
        df.lo.to_numpy(float)[keep],
        df.c.to_numpy(float)[keep],
    )


def mt5_atr(h: FloatArray, lo: FloatArray, c: FloatArray, n: int = 14) -> FloatArray:
    """foundation.atr: the simple average of n true ranges; bar 0 has no previous close (NaN)."""
    pc = np.r_[np.nan, c[:-1]]
    tr = np.maximum(h, pc) - np.minimum(lo, pc)
    if len(tr):
        tr[0] = np.nan
    return np.asarray(pd.Series(tr).rolling(n).mean().to_numpy(), float)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Pivots:
    b: np.ndarray  # bar
    p: FloatArray  # price
    k: np.ndarray  # +1 peak, -1 trough
    conf: np.ndarray  # the bar that confirmed it

    def mirror(self) -> Pivots:
        return Pivots(self.b, -self.p, -self.k, self.conf)


def zigzag(h: FloatArray, lo: FloatArray, atr: FloatArray, k: float = ZZ_K) -> Pivots:
    """patterns.zigzag: the causal ATR ZigZag (each bar reads bars <= it)."""
    piv: list[tuple[int, float, int, int]] = []
    fin = np.isfinite(atr)
    if not fin.any():
        e = np.empty(0, int)
        return Pivots(e, np.empty(0), e, e)
    i0 = int(np.argmax(fin))
    hi_i = lo_i = ext = i0
    direction = 0
    for i in range(i0, len(h)):
        thr = k * atr[i]
        if not np.isfinite(thr):
            continue
        if direction == 0:
            if h[i] > h[hi_i]:
                hi_i = i
            if lo[i] < lo[lo_i]:
                lo_i = i
            if hi_i != lo_i and h[hi_i] - lo[lo_i] >= thr:
                if lo_i < hi_i:
                    piv.append((lo_i, float(lo[lo_i]), -1, i))
                    direction, ext = 1, hi_i
                else:
                    piv.append((hi_i, float(h[hi_i]), 1, i))
                    direction, ext = -1, lo_i
        elif direction == 1:
            if h[i] >= h[ext]:
                ext = i
            elif h[ext] - lo[i] >= thr:
                piv.append((ext, float(h[ext]), 1, i))
                direction, ext = -1, i
        else:
            if lo[i] <= lo[ext]:
                ext = i
            elif h[i] - lo[ext] >= thr:
                piv.append((ext, float(lo[ext]), -1, i))
                direction, ext = 1, i
    a = np.array(piv, dtype=float).reshape(-1, 4)
    return Pivots(a[:, 0].astype(int), a[:, 1], a[:, 2].astype(int), a[:, 3].astype(int))


Swing = tuple[int, float, int, bool]


def structure(piv: Pivots, h: FloatArray, lo: FloatArray, d: int, keep: int = 6) -> list[Swing]:
    """patterns.structure: the last *keep* pivots confirmed by d, then the running extreme since the last
    one."""
    n = int(np.searchsorted(piv.conf, d, side="right"))
    out: list[Swing] = [
        (int(piv.b[j]), float(piv.p[j]), int(piv.k[j]), False) for j in range(max(n - keep, 0), n)
    ]
    if n:
        last_b, last_k = int(piv.b[n - 1]), int(piv.k[n - 1])
        if last_b < d:
            if last_k == 1:
                j = last_b + 1 + int(np.argmin(lo[last_b + 1 : d + 1]))
                out.append((j, float(lo[j]), -1, True))
            else:
                j = last_b + 1 + int(np.argmax(h[last_b + 1 : d + 1]))
                out.append((j, float(h[j]), 1, True))
    return out


def m_structure(piv: Pivots, d: int) -> str:
    """patterns.m_structure: up / down / mixed from the last two confirmed troughs and peaks ('none' if
    fewer)."""
    n = int(np.searchsorted(piv.conf, d, side="right"))
    tr = piv.p[:n][piv.k[:n] == -1][-2:]
    pk = piv.p[:n][piv.k[:n] == 1][-2:]
    if len(tr) < 2 or len(pk) < 2:
        return "none"
    if tr[1] > tr[0] and pk[1] > pk[0]:
        return "up"
    if tr[1] < tr[0] and pk[1] < pk[0]:
        return "down"
    return "mixed"


def last_swing(piv: Pivots, b: int, kind: int) -> float:
    """p2_trades.last_pivot_prices at bar b: the price of the last pivot of *kind* confirmed by b (NaN if
    none)."""
    n = int(np.searchsorted(piv.conf, b, side="right"))
    x = piv.p[:n][piv.k[:n] == kind]
    return float(x[-1]) if len(x) else math.nan


# --- patterns -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def first_close_above(c: FloatArray, line: FloatArray, a: int, d: int) -> bool:
    return bool(c[d] > line[-1] and np.all(c[a:d] <= line[:-1]))


def find_buy(
    h: FloatArray, lo: FloatArray, c: FloatArray, atr: float, seq: list[Swing], d: int
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """patterns.find_buy: inverse H&S, W, the sweep then the higher low, breaking out at bar d."""
    if len(seq) < 3 or not np.isfinite(atr):
        return []
    k3 = len(seq) - 1 if seq[-1][2] == -1 else len(seq) - 2
    if k3 < 2 or seq[k3][2] != -1:
        return []
    t3, p2, t2 = seq[k3], seq[k3 - 1], seq[k3 - 2]
    out: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    if first_close_above(c, np.full(d - t3[0] + 1, p2[1]), t3[0], d):
        hgt = p2[1] - min(t2[1], t3[1])
        eq = max(EQ_ATR * atr, EQ_H * hgt)
        base = dict(trigger=p2[1], height=hgt, start=t2[0])
        pts = [(t2[0], t2[1], "L1"), (p2[0], p2[1], "P"), (t3[0], t3[1], "L2")]
        if d - t2[0] <= SPAN["w"]:
            if abs(t3[1] - t2[1]) <= eq:
                out.append(
                    dict(
                        family="w",
                        variant="W",
                        extreme=min(t2[1], t3[1]),
                        higher_low=t3[1],
                        points=pts,
                        **base,
                    )
                )
            elif t2[1] - SWEEP_W_H * hgt <= t3[1] < t2[1] - eq:
                out.append(
                    dict(
                        family="w",
                        variant="W, the 2nd low swept the 1st",
                        extreme=t3[1],
                        higher_low=t3[1],
                        points=pts,
                        **base,
                    )
                )
        if d - t2[0] <= SPAN["st"] and t3[1] > t2[1] + eq:
            out.append(
                dict(
                    family="st",
                    variant="sweep, higher low",
                    extreme=t2[1],
                    higher_low=t3[1],
                    points=[(t2[0], t2[1], "S"), (p2[0], p2[1], "P"), (t3[0], t3[1], "HL")],
                    **base,
                )
            )
    if k3 >= 4:
        t1, p1 = seq[k3 - 4], seq[k3 - 3]
        if d - t1[0] <= SPAN["ihs"] and p2[0] > p1[0]:
            slope = (p2[1] - p1[1]) / (p2[0] - p1[0])
            line = p1[1] + slope * (np.arange(t3[0], d + 1) - p1[0])
            hgt = p1[1] + slope * (t2[0] - p1[0]) - t2[1]
            if (
                t2[1] < min(t1[1], t3[1]) - HEAD_ATR * atr
                and abs(t1[1] - t3[1]) <= SHOULDER_H * hgt
                and abs(p2[1] - p1[1]) <= NECK_H * hgt
                and first_close_above(c, line, t3[0], d)
            ):
                out.append(
                    dict(
                        family="ihs",
                        variant="inverse H&S",
                        extreme=t2[1],
                        higher_low=t3[1],
                        trigger=float(line[-1]),
                        height=hgt,
                        start=t1[0],
                        points=[
                            (t1[0], t1[1], "LS"),
                            (p1[0], p1[1], "N1"),
                            (t2[0], t2[1], "Head"),
                            (p2[0], p2[1], "N2"),
                            (t3[0], t3[1], "RS"),
                        ],
                    )
                )
    return out


def find_base(h: FloatArray, lo: FloatArray, c: FloatArray, atr: FloatArray, d: int) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """patterns.find_base: the longest run of 8 .. 40 bars ending at d - 1 within 1.5 x ATR(d - 1), broken
    at d."""
    if d - BASE_MIN < 0 or not np.isfinite(atr[d - 1]):
        return []
    w = BASE_W * atr[d - 1]
    best = None
    hi, low = -np.inf, np.inf
    for n in range(1, min(BASE_MAX, d) + 1):
        hi, low = max(hi, h[d - n]), min(low, lo[d - n])
        if hi - low > w:
            break
        if n >= BASE_MIN:
            best = (n, hi, low)
    if best is None:
        return []
    n, hi, low = best
    side = 1 if c[d] > hi else -1 if c[d] < low else 0
    if not side:
        return []
    return [
        dict(
            family="base",
            variant="base",
            side=side,
            extreme=low if side > 0 else hi,
            trigger=hi if side > 0 else low,
            height=hi - low,
            start=d - n,
            box=(d - n, d - 1, low, hi),
            higher_low=np.nan,
            points=[(d - n, low if side > 0 else hi, "base")],
        )
    ]


def unmirror(p: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    q = dict(p)
    for key in ("extreme", "trigger", "higher_low"):
        q[key] = -p[key]
    q["points"] = [(b, -x, SELL_LABELS.get(lab, lab)) for b, x, lab in p["points"]]
    q["side"] = -1
    q["variant"] = SELL_NAMES[p["variant"]]
    return q


def patterns_at(b: Bars, atr: FloatArray, piv: Pivots, d: int) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """patterns.patterns_at: every pattern breaking out at bar d, both sides, no taller than 4 x ATR(d)."""
    out = [dict(p, side=1) for p in find_buy(b.h, b.lo, b.c, atr[d], structure(piv, b.h, b.lo, d), d)]
    mh, ml, mc, mp = -b.lo, -b.h, -b.c, piv.mirror()
    out += [unmirror(p) for p in find_buy(mh, ml, mc, atr[d], structure(mp, mh, ml, d), d)]
    out += find_base(b.h, b.lo, b.c, atr, d)
    out = [p for p in out if p["height"] <= HEIGHT_ATR * atr[d]]
    for p in out:
        p["stop"] = p["extreme"] - p["side"] * STOP_ATR * atr[d]
        p["d"] = d
        p["atr"] = float(atr[d])
    return out


def at_level(
    p: dict[str, Any], close: float, levels: Sequence[tuple[float, str]], z: float, sweep: float
) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    """patterns.at_level: 'at', 'swept' or 'base' against the levels; the nearest to the extreme wins."""
    s, ext = p["side"], p["extreme"]
    best: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    for lv, kind in levels:
        how: str | None
        if p["family"] == "base":
            lo_b, hi_b = p["box"][2], p["box"][3]
            how = "base" if (lo_b <= lv + z and hi_b >= lv - z) else None
        else:
            past = s * (lv - ext) - z
            if abs(ext - lv) <= z:
                how = "at"
            elif 0 < past <= sweep and s * (close - (lv - s * z)) > 0:
                how = "swept"
            else:
                how = None
            if p["family"] == "st" and (how != "swept" or s * (p["higher_low"] - (lv - s * z)) < 0):
                how = None
        if how is not None:
            dist = abs(ext - lv)
            if best is None or dist < best["dist"]:
                best = dict(level=lv, level_kind=kind, how=how, dist=dist)
    return best


def next_level(levels: FloatArray, entry: float, side: int, z: float, own: float) -> float:
    v = levels[(np.abs(levels - own) > z) & (side * (levels - entry) > z)]
    if not len(v):
        return math.nan
    return float(v.min() if side > 0 else v.max())


def confirm_b(
    h: FloatArray,
    lo: FloatArray,
    c: FloatArray,
    d: int,
    extreme: float,
    atr: float,
    side: int,
    max_wait: int = 30,
    pb_atr: float = 1.0,
) -> dict[str, float] | None:
    """p2_trades.confirm_b: the pullback of pb_atr x ATR from the post-breakout high, then the first close
    above the frozen high, within max_wait bars after d; None if a low reaches the extreme first."""
    if side < 0:
        x = confirm_b(-lo, -h, -c, d, -extreme, atr, 1, max_wait, pb_atr)
        return None if x is None else dict(k=x["k"], hi=-x["hi"], pull=-x["pull"])
    hi, pulled, pull = h[d], False, np.inf
    for k in range(d + 1, min(d + max_wait, len(c) - 1) + 1):
        if lo[k] <= extreme:
            return None
        if not pulled:
            if h[k] > hi:
                hi = h[k]
            elif hi - lo[k] >= pb_atr * atr:
                pulled, pull = True, lo[k]
            continue
        pull = min(pull, lo[k])
        if c[k] > hi:
            return dict(k=float(k), hi=float(hi), pull=float(pull))
    return None


# --- the owner's H1 levels (zones.levels_at) --------------------------------------------------------------


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class LevelInputs:
    avail: np.ndarray  # H1 bars complete by the evaluation, int64 ns
    h: FloatArray
    lo: FloatArray
    atr: FloatArray
    s_i: np.ndarray  # the fractal swings: bar, price, kind, known
    s_p: FloatArray
    s_k: np.ndarray
    s_known: np.ndarray
    d_avail: np.ndarray  # D1 (server day) bars complete by the evaluation
    d_high: FloatArray
    d_low: FloatArray


def fractals(h: FloatArray, lo: FloatArray, k: int) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """foundation.fractals: the highest high / lowest low of the k bars on each side (equal ones each
    count)."""
    hw = pd.Series(h).rolling(2 * k + 1, center=True).max().to_numpy()
    lw = pd.Series(lo).rolling(2 * k + 1, center=True).min().to_numpy()
    return np.nonzero((h == hw) & np.isfinite(hw))[0], np.nonzero((lo == lw) & np.isfinite(lw))[0]


def _groups(
    opens: pd.DatetimeIndex, h: FloatArray, lo: FloatArray, c: FloatArray, key: pd.DatetimeIndex
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = pd.DataFrame({"h": h, "lo": lo, "c": c, "t": opens.as_unit("ns").to_numpy(dtype="datetime64[ns]")})
    g = df.groupby(pd.DatetimeIndex(key).as_unit("ns").to_numpy(dtype="datetime64[ns]"), sort=True)
    out = pd.DataFrame({"h": g.h.max(), "lo": g.lo.min(), "c": g.c.last(), "last": g.t.max()})
    out["avail"] = out["last"].to_numpy(dtype="datetime64[ns]").astype(np.int64) + NS_MIN
    return out


def level_inputs(
    opens: pd.DatetimeIndex, h: FloatArray, lo: FloatArray, c: FloatArray, t: pd.Timestamp
) -> LevelInputs:
    """patterns.level_inputs from the M1 bars closed by *t*: H1 bars on the UTC hour and D1 bars on the
    server day (avail = the last M1 bar's open + 1 minute, as indicators.bars), keeping only the ones whose
    hour / server day is over by *t* (the research's bars come from the full history: a running bar is not
    complete there)."""
    tn = pd.Timestamp(t).as_unit("ns").value
    hours = opens.floor("h")
    h1 = _groups(opens, h, lo, c, hours)
    end = (
        pd.DatetimeIndex(h1.index).as_unit("ns").to_numpy(dtype="datetime64[ns]").astype(np.int64)
        + 60 * NS_MIN
    )
    h1 = h1[end <= tn]
    hh, ll, cc = h1.h.to_numpy(float), h1.lo.to_numpy(float), h1.c.to_numpy(float)
    av = h1.avail.to_numpy(np.int64)
    hi_i, lo_i = fractals(hh, ll, H1_K)
    rows = sorted(
        [(int(i), float(hh[i]), 1) for i in hi_i] + [(int(i), float(ll[i]), -1) for i in lo_i],
        key=lambda r: (r[0], r[2]),  # zones.swings: sorted by bar, then kind
    )
    rows = [r for r in rows if r[0] + H1_K < len(hh)]
    s_i = np.array([r[0] for r in rows], int)
    local = opens.tz_convert(ATHENS).tz_localize(None).floor("1D")
    d1 = _groups(opens, h, lo, c, pd.DatetimeIndex(local))
    days = pd.DatetimeIndex(d1.index) + pd.Timedelta(days=1)
    day_end = (
        days.tz_localize(ATHENS)
        .tz_convert("UTC")
        .as_unit("ns")
        .to_numpy(dtype="datetime64[ns]")
        .astype(np.int64)
    )
    d1 = d1[day_end <= tn]
    return LevelInputs(
        av,
        hh,
        ll,
        mt5_atr(hh, ll, cc),
        s_i,
        np.array([r[1] for r in rows], float),
        np.array([r[2] for r in rows], int),
        av[s_i + H1_K] if len(s_i) else np.empty(0, np.int64),
        d1.avail.to_numpy(np.int64),
        d1.h.to_numpy(float),
        d1.lo.to_numpy(float),
    )


def merge(prices: FloatArray, kinds: np.ndarray, tol: float) -> list[tuple[float, int, int, int]]:
    """zones.merge: sorted; a price joins the zone while within tol of its first price -> (mean, touches,
    tops, lows)."""
    o = np.argsort(prices, kind="stable")
    v, kd = np.asarray(prices, float)[o], np.asarray(kinds)[o]
    rows, a = [], 0
    for j in range(1, len(v) + 1):
        if j == len(v) or v[j] - v[a] > tol:
            rows.append((float(v[a:j].mean()), j - a, int((kd[a:j] > 0).sum()), int((kd[a:j] < 0).sum())))
            a = j
    return rows


def levels_at(
    y: LevelInputs, t_ns: int, price: float, win: int = WIN
) -> tuple[list[tuple[float, str]], float]:
    """zones.levels_at: the owner's levels known at t_ns, strongest first, and that H1 ATR."""
    bi = int(np.searchsorted(y.avail, t_ns, side="right")) - 1
    if bi < 0 or not np.isfinite(y.atr[bi]):
        return [], math.nan
    a = float(y.atr[bi])
    sel = (y.s_known <= t_ns) & (y.s_i > bi - win)
    zones = merge(y.s_p[sel], y.s_k[sel], TOL_ATR * a) if sel.any() else []
    cand: list[tuple[float, str]] = []
    for zp, touches, tops, lows in zones:
        if touches >= 3 or (tops and lows):
            cand.append((zp, "x3+ / flip"))
        elif touches == 2:
            cand.append((zp, "x2"))
    a0 = max(bi - win + 1, 0)
    cand += [(float(y.h[a0 : bi + 1].max()), "5d high"), (float(y.lo[a0 : bi + 1].min()), "5d low")]
    kd = int(np.searchsorted(y.d_avail, t_ns, side="right")) - 1
    if kd >= 0:
        cand += [(float(y.d_high[kd]), "PDH"), (float(y.d_low[kd]), "PDL")]
    si, sp, sk = y.s_i[sel], y.s_p[sel], y.s_k[sel]
    tops = (sk == 1) & (sp > price)
    lows = (sk == -1) & (sp < price)
    if tops.any():
        cand.append((float(sp[tops][int(np.argmax(si[tops]))]), "last top"))
    if lows.any():
        cand.append((float(sp[lows][int(np.argmax(si[lows]))]), "last low"))
    cand.sort(key=lambda x: ORDER.index(x[1]))
    kept: list[tuple[float, str]] = []
    for cnd in cand:
        if all(abs(cnd[0] - k[0]) > TOL_ATR * a for k in kept):
            kept.append(cnd)
    return kept, a


# --- the strategy -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Candidate:
    side: int
    stop: float
    risk_dec: float
    pattern: dict[str, Any]
    level: dict[str, Any]
    z: float
    h1_atr_dec: float
    next_level: float
    t_dec: int
    conf: dict[str, float]
    close: float


@dataclass
class _Frame:
    """One evaluation's readings of the strategy's timeframe."""

    bars: Bars
    atr: FloatArray
    piv: Pivots
    extra: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)


class Plan1B2Params(StrategyParams):
    window: str = "07:00-09:00"  # entry (confirmation) times, [start, end)
    window_zone: str = "Asia/Bangkok"
    max_wait_bars: int = Field(
        default=30, ge=1, le=240
    )  # the confirmation within this many bars after the pattern
    pullback_atr: float = Field(default=1.0, gt=0, le=10)
    hold_bars: int = Field(default=60, ge=1, le=1440)  # out after this many of the TF's bars
    # journal week 6: a second B2 of the morning only in the first one's direction (on in the frozen rules,
    # CHECKLIST 61-63; the journal deleted it in week 29: a switch)
    second_same_side: bool = True
    # no level beyond 1 R: the research has no target; the risk checks need one, so a far one (in R: a B2 stop
    # can be 90 USD wide)
    target_cap_r: float = Field(default=10.0, gt=1, le=50)
    atr_floor: float | None = Field(default=None, gt=0, le=1000)
    d1_atr20_min_usd: float | None = Field(
        default=60.0, gt=0, le=1000
    )  # the regime switch (row 62); None = off

    @field_validator("window")
    @classmethod
    def _check_window(cls, value: str) -> str:
        start, sep, end = value.partition("-")
        if not sep or hhmm(start) >= hhmm(end):
            raise ValueError(f"window: {value!r} is not 'HH:MM-HH:MM' with start < end")
        return value

    @field_validator("window_zone")
    @classmethod
    def _check_zone(cls, value: str) -> str:
        try:
            ZoneInfo(value)
        except (ZoneInfoNotFoundError, ValueError) as exc:
            raise ValueError(f"unknown time zone {value!r}") from exc
        return value


def in_window(t: pd.Timestamp, window: str, zone: str) -> bool:
    """p4_trades.window_of: start included, end excluded, in *zone*."""
    local = t.tz_convert(zone)
    start, _, end = window.partition("-")
    s, e = hhmm(start), hhmm(end)
    m = local.hour * 60 + local.minute + local.second / 60
    return s.hour * 60 + s.minute <= m < e.hour * 60 + e.minute


class Plan1B2(BaseStrategy):
    """Asia B2 on M1 patterns (lane ``plan1``)."""

    name = "setup_plan1_b2"
    version = "1.0.0"
    description = (
        "Setup OWN PLAN-1, Asia B2 on M1: a chart pattern at the owner's H1 level, a pullback and a new "
        "close, 07:00-09:00 Thai; the structure exit; M1 gold. Lane only. Unproven."
    )
    Params = Plan1B2Params
    advised = False
    minutes: ClassVar[int] = 1
    entry_group: ClassVar[tuple[str, ...]] = ("setup_plan1_b2", "setup_plan1_b2m5")

    def __init__(self, params: StrategyParams | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(params)
        self._entries: dict[str, list[PastEntry]] = {}

    def required_timeframes(self) -> tuple[Timeframe, ...]:
        return (Timeframe.M1,)

    def warmup_bars(self) -> int:
        return (
            10_000  # 125 complete H1 bars (the levels' 120) across a weekend; the ZigZag settles well within
        )

    def wants_bar(self, at: datetime) -> bool:
        p: Plan1B2Params = self.params
        t = pd.Timestamp(at)
        return in_window(t, p.window, p.window_zone) and not t.value % (self.minutes * NS_MIN)

    def attach_entries(self, symbol: str, entries: Sequence[PastEntry]) -> None:
        self._entries[symbol] = sorted(entries, key=lambda e: e.at)

    # readings ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _frame(self, m1: pd.DataFrame, at: pd.Timestamp) -> _Frame | None:
        opens = pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(m1["open_time"], utc=True))
        o, h, lo, c = (m1[k].to_numpy(dtype=float) for k in ("open", "high", "low", "close"))
        b = tf_bars(opens, o, h, lo, c, self.minutes, at)
        if len(b.c) < 30 or b.avail[-1] != at.as_unit("ns").value:
            return None
        atr = mt5_atr(b.h, b.lo, b.c)
        return _Frame(b, atr, zigzag(b.h, b.lo, atr), {"opens": opens, "o": o, "h": h, "lo": lo, "c": c})

    def candidates(self, f: _Frame, y: LevelInputs | None = None) -> list[Candidate]:
        """The patterns of the last ``max_wait_bars`` bars confirmed by the last bar, located at a level,
        sorted by the risk at the confirming close (patterns.locate + p3_trades.candidates3)."""
        p: Plan1B2Params = self.params
        b, k = f.bars, len(f.bars.c) - 1
        x = f.extra
        out: list[Candidate] = []
        for d in range(max(k - p.max_wait_bars, 0), k):
            if not np.isfinite(f.atr[d]):
                continue
            for pat in patterns_at(b, f.atr, f.piv, d):
                conf = confirm_b(
                    b.h[: k + 1],
                    b.lo[: k + 1],
                    b.c[: k + 1],
                    d,
                    pat["extreme"],
                    pat["atr"],
                    pat["side"],
                    p.max_wait_bars,
                    p.pullback_atr,
                )
                if conf is None or int(conf["k"]) != k:
                    continue
                if d + 1 > k or b.t_open[d + 1] != b.avail[d]:
                    continue  # the research's entry needs the bar opening at the decision (patterns.locate)
                t_dec = int(b.avail[d])
                if y is None:  # read only when a pattern confirms (most bars have none)
                    y = level_inputs(
                        x["opens"], x["h"], x["lo"], x["c"], pd.Timestamp(int(b.avail[k]), tz="UTC")
                    )
                levels, a1 = levels_at(y, t_dec, float(b.c[d]))
                if not np.isfinite(a1) or not levels:
                    continue
                z = ZONE_H1 * a1
                hit = at_level(pat, float(b.c[d]), levels, z, SWEEP_H1 * a1)
                if hit is None:
                    continue
                prices = np.array([lv for lv, _ in levels], float)
                nl = next_level(prices, float(b.o[d + 1]), pat["side"], z, hit["level"])
                close = float(b.c[k])
                out.append(
                    Candidate(
                        pat["side"],
                        pat["stop"],
                        abs(close - pat["stop"]),
                        pat,
                        hit,
                        z,
                        a1,
                        nl,
                        t_dec,
                        conf,
                        close,
                    )
                )
        return sorted(out, key=lambda q: q.risk_dec)

    # the contract ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def evaluate(self, ctx: StrategyContext) -> Signal:
        p: Plan1B2Params = self.params
        market = ctx.market
        at = pd.Timestamp(market.decision_time_utc)
        if market.entry_timeframe is not Timeframe.M1:
            return self.hold(ctx, ReasonCode.DATA_QUALITY, explanation="B2 runs on an M1 lane")
        if not in_window(at, p.window, p.window_zone):
            return self.hold(ctx, ReasonCode.OUTSIDE_SESSION, explanation=f"{at:%a %H:%M} UTC")
        if at.value % (self.minutes * NS_MIN):
            return self.hold(ctx, ReasonCode.NO_SETUP, explanation=f"not an M{self.minutes} close")
        f = self._frame(ctx.frame(Timeframe.M1), at)
        if f is None:
            return self.hold(ctx, ReasonCode.INSUFFICIENT_DATA, explanation="too few bars")
        cands = self.candidates(f)
        if not cands:
            return self.hold(ctx, ReasonCode.NO_SETUP, explanation="no confirmed pattern at a level")
        q = cands[0]
        buy = q.side > 0
        price = market.ask if buy else market.bid
        if price is None:
            return self.hold(ctx, ReasonCode.DATA_QUALITY, explanation="no quote")
        risk = q.side * (price - q.stop)
        if not risk > 0:
            return self.hold(ctx, ReasonCode.NO_SETUP, explanation=f"the price {price:.2f} is past the stop")
        target = (
            q.next_level if np.isfinite(q.next_level) and q.side * (q.next_level - price) > risk else math.nan
        )
        conds, ok = self.journal(ctx, f, q, at, price, risk, target)
        if not ok:
            return self.hold(ctx, ReasonCode.NO_SETUP, conditions=conds, explanation=explain(conds))
        tp = target if np.isfinite(target) else price + q.side * p.target_cap_r * risk
        return self.entry(
            ctx,
            Action.BUY if buy else Action.SELL,
            entry_price=price,
            stop_loss=q.stop,
            take_profit=tp,
            conditions=conds,
            score=max(0.0, 100.0 - q.risk_dec),  # the smaller risk ranks first (the research's order)
            explanation=explain(conds),
        )

    def journal(
        self,
        ctx: StrategyContext,
        f: _Frame,
        q: Candidate,
        at: pd.Timestamp,
        price: float,
        risk: float,
        target: float,
    ) -> tuple[list[Condition], bool]:
        p: Plan1B2Params = self.params
        x, b = f.extra, f.bars
        pat = q.pattern
        tf = f"M{self.minutes}"
        h1 = h1_atr_at(x["opens"], x["h"], x["lo"], x["c"], at)
        floor_ok = p.atr_floor is None or (math.isfinite(h1) and h1 >= p.atr_floor)
        change = h4_change_at(ctx, at)
        side_ok, side_text = self.second_trade(ctx.symbol, at, q.side)
        pts = ", ".join(
            f"{lab} {px:.2f} @{pd.Timestamp(int(b.t_open[i]), tz='UTC'):%H:%M}"
            for i, px, lab in pat["points"]
        )
        other = "-"
        if self.minutes == 1:
            b5 = tf_bars(x["opens"], x["o"], x["h"], x["lo"], x["c"], 5, at)
            if len(b5.c) > 30:
                a5 = mt5_atr(b5.h, b5.lo, b5.c)
                other = f"M5 structure {m_structure(zigzag(b5.h, b5.lo, a5), len(b5.c) - 1)}"
        else:
            other = f"M1 structure {m_structure(*self._m1_piv(x, at))}"
        conds = [
            Condition(
                "rule",
                True,
                1.0,
                f"Asia B2 {tf}: {pat['variant']} ({NAMES[(pat['family'], q.side)]}) broke out at "
                f"{pd.Timestamp(q.t_dec, tz='UTC'):%H:%M} UTC; pullback to {q.conf['pull']:.2f}, close "
                f"{q.close:.2f} beyond {q.conf['hi']:.2f}",
            ),
            Condition("h1_atr", floor_ok, 1.0, atr_detail(h1, p.atr_floor)),
            regime(ctx, at, p.d1_atr20_min_usd),
            Condition(
                "level",
                True,
                1.0,
                f"{q.level['level']:.2f} {q.level['level_kind']} ({q.level['how']}), zone +-{q.z:.2f}; "
                "next level " + ("none" if not np.isfinite(q.next_level) else f"{q.next_level:.2f}"),
            ),
            Condition(
                "pattern", True, 1.0, f"{pts}; extreme {pat['extreme']:.2f}, height {pat['height']:.2f}"
            ),
            Condition("agreement", True, 1.0, other),
            Condition("pools", True, 1.0, pools_detail(pools(x["opens"], x["o"], x["h"], x["lo"], at))),
            Condition(
                "h4_atr_change",
                True,
                1.0,
                "H4 ATR(14) over 6 H4 bars "
                + ("unknown" if not math.isfinite(change) else f"{100 * change:+.1f} %"),
            ),
            Condition("second_trade", side_ok, 1.0, side_text),
            Condition(
                "stop_distance",
                True,
                1.0,
                f"{risk:.2f} to {q.stop:.2f} (0.2 ATR past the extreme); target "
                + (
                    f"{target:.2f} (the next level)"
                    if np.isfinite(target)
                    else f"none (no level beyond 1 R; a cap at {p.target_cap_r:g} R)"
                ),
            ),
            Condition("spread", True, 1.0, spread_detail(ctx.market.bid, ctx.market.ask, ctx)),
        ]
        return conds, floor_ok and side_ok and conds[2].passed

    def _m1_piv(self, x: dict[str, Any], at: pd.Timestamp) -> tuple[Pivots, int]:
        b1 = tf_bars(x["opens"], x["o"], x["h"], x["lo"], x["c"], 1, at)
        a1 = mt5_atr(b1.h, b1.lo, b1.c)
        return zigzag(b1.h, b1.lo, a1), len(b1.c) - 1

    def second_trade(self, symbol: str, at: pd.Timestamp, side: int) -> tuple[bool, str]:
        """Week 6: the morning's first B2 entry (the Thai day of *at*) sets the side of any later one."""
        p: Plan1B2Params = self.params
        day = at.tz_convert(p.window_zone).date()
        today = [
            e
            for e in self._entries.get(symbol, [])
            if pd.Timestamp(e.at).tz_convert(p.window_zone).date() == day and pd.Timestamp(e.at) < at
        ]
        if not today:
            return True, "the first B2 of the morning"
        first = today[0]
        same = (first.side is Side.BUY) == (side > 0)
        text = (
            f"B2 #{len(today) + 1} of the morning; the first: {first.side.value} at "
            f"{pd.Timestamp(first.at).tz_convert(p.window_zone):%H:%M} ({first.strategy})"
        )
        if not p.second_same_side:
            return True, text + "; rule off"
        return same, text + ("; same side" if same else "; a flip: skipped")

    def manage_position(self, ctx: StrategyContext, pos: OpenPosition) -> PositionAdvice | None:
        """The structure exit at the close of the TF bar beyond the last confirmed swing low (a buy) / high (a
        sell), and out after ``hold_bars`` TF bars (p2_trades.structure_exit_time, p3's time limit)."""
        p: Plan1B2Params = self.params
        at = pd.Timestamp(ctx.decision_time_utc)
        step = self.minutes * NS_MIN
        t_entry = (pd.Timestamp(pos.entry_time).value // step) * step
        if at.value >= t_entry + p.hold_bars * step:
            return PositionAdvice(close=ExitReason.TIME_STOP, note=f"{p.hold_bars} M{self.minutes} bars")
        if at.value % step:
            return None
        f = self._frame(ctx.frame(Timeframe.M1), at)
        if f is None:
            return None
        bk = len(f.bars.c) - 1
        if f.bars.t_open[bk] < t_entry:
            return None
        buy = pos.side is Side.BUY
        swing = last_swing(f.piv, bk, -1 if buy else 1)
        close = float(f.bars.c[bk])
        if np.isfinite(swing) and (close < swing if buy else close > swing):
            return PositionAdvice(
                close=ExitReason.SIGNAL, note=f"structure: close {close:.2f} beyond {swing:.2f}"
            )
        return None


class Plan1B2M5(Plan1B2):
    """Asia B2 on M5 patterns (bars built from M1 on the clock)."""

    name = "setup_plan1_b2m5"
    description = (
        "Setup OWN PLAN-1, Asia B2 on M5: a chart pattern at the owner's H1 level, a pullback and a new "
        "close, 07:00-09:00 Thai; the structure exit; gold. Lane only. Unproven."
    )
    minutes: ClassVar[int] = 5
"""Which side has the edge on a timeframe LARGER than the one the trade is entered on.

The owner's rule, 2026-10-27: *"every trade takes only the side with the edge on a timeframe larger than
the entry timeframe"*, and their correction the same day: *"D1 should not be that rigid - it is a
quantity, not a gate; the more momentum there is, the further that side runs."*

So the frame's lean is read as a **number**, not a label: the close's distance from its own 50-bar mean,
in that frame's own 14-bar ATR, signed (positive = leaning up). A trade is allowed when the lean is on
its side; the threshold is zero, not a fitted number.

**The frame is H4, measured** (`research/2026-10-26-three-bots/RULES_LOCKED.md`, rule set 2; 239 trades,
2023-09 .. 2026-10-24). Correlation of "lean behind the trade" with the trade's R: H4 +0.156, H1 +0.048,
D1 +0.030 - the middle frame carries it, nearer than the day and slower than the hour. Requiring the H4
lean to be on the trade's side moves the three bots from +0.102 to +0.210 R a trade, and the two halves
of the history agree to 0.007 R (+0.214 fitted, +0.207 never seen) - the reason this rule was taken and
an H1 one was not.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import math
from collections.abc import Mapping

import pandas as pd

from app.core.enums import Side, Timeframe
from app.indicators.volatility import atr

MEAN_BARS = 50
ATR_BARS = 14
HOURS = {Timeframe.H1: 1, Timeframe.H4: 4, Timeframe.D1: 24}


def resample_from_h1(h1: pd.DataFrame, hours: int) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Bars of ``hours`` from the lane's H1 frame, indexed by each bar's OPEN.

    App frames are stamped at the bar's CLOSE, so the index is shifted back one hour first; the research
    harness reads history stamped at the open and shifts nothing. Getting this backwards costs an hour of
    lookahead, which is how a day of conclusions went wrong on 2026-10-27.
    """
    opens = h1.copy()
    opens.index = pd.DatetimeIndex(opens.index) - pd.Timedelta(hours=1)
    rule = f"{hours}h" if hours < 24 else "1D"
    return opens.resample(rule).agg({"open": "first", "high": "max", "low": "min", "close": "last"}).dropna()


def edge_lean(
    frames: Mapping[Timeframe, pd.DataFrame],
    at: pd.Timestamp,
    entry: Timeframe,
    *,
    frame: Timeframe = Timeframe.H4,
) -> float | None:
    """The signed lean of ``frame``, or ``None`` when it cannot be read from a closed bar.

    ``None`` never means "allowed": a caller that cannot read the frame above its entry has no edge side
    and does not trade. ``entry`` must be smaller than ``frame`` - the rule is meaningless otherwise, and
    a ``ValueError`` here stops it being read from the entry frame by accident.
    """
    if entry.seconds >= frame.seconds:
        raise ValueError(f"the entry frame {entry.value} must be smaller than {frame.value}")
    hours = HOURS.get(frame)
    if hours is None:
        raise ValueError(f"{frame.value} is not read from the H1 frame")

    h1 = frames.get(Timeframe.H1)
    if h1 is None or "close" not in h1:
        return None
    bars = resample_from_h1(h1, hours)
    closed = bars[(bars.index + pd.Timedelta(hours=hours)) <= pd.Timestamp(at)]
    if len(closed) < MEAN_BARS + ATR_BARS:
        return None
    mean = float(closed.close.rolling(MEAN_BARS).mean().iloc[-1])
    width = float(atr(closed.high, closed.low, closed.close, ATR_BARS).iloc[-1])
    if not math.isfinite(mean) or not math.isfinite(width) or width <= 0:
        return None
    lean = (float(closed.close.iloc[-1]) - mean) / width
    # A non-finite lean must never reach a caller: `nan < 0` is False, so a NaN would sail through a
    # gate written as "refuse when the lean is negative" and open a trade on no evidence at all
    # (found by the developer session reviewing this gate while it was live, 2026-10-27).
    # It IS reachable, though I first wrote that it was not: a finite, positive but tiny ATR (1e-320)
    # overflows the division to infinity while passing both guards above. The developer session found
    # that and was right (2026-10-27); the case now has its own test.
    return lean if math.isfinite(lean) else None


def behind(lean: float | None, side: Side) -> float | None:
    """``lean`` seen from a trade's own side: positive means the frame leans the trade's way."""
    if lean is None:
        return None
    return lean if side is Side.BUY else -lean


def edge_side(
    frames: Mapping[Timeframe, pd.DataFrame],
    at: pd.Timestamp,
    entry: Timeframe,
    *,
    frame: Timeframe = Timeframe.H4,
) -> Side | None:
    """The side ``frame`` leans towards, for callers that want one answer rather than the number.

    A lean of exactly zero is on neither side and returns ``None``; the measured rule is "at least 0 on
    the trade's own side", so a strategy that cares about that boundary uses :func:`behind` instead.
    """
    lean = edge_lean(frames, at, entry, frame=frame)
    if lean is None or lean == 0:
        return None
    return Side.BUY if lean > 0 else Side.SELL
"""The trading day's plan, as a gate rather than a reminder (P26).

The owner, 2026-10-25: every trading day starts with the plan - the market's condition, yesterday's
levels, the trend, the side with the edge, the turn/go-on scenarios - written and summarised before
anything is traded. It was recorded as a principle (P26), as a knowledge-base entry and as a memory, and
on the evening of 2026-10-27 the engine still opened a DEMO session with no plan at all. The owner:
*"I went to the trouble of telling you to write it down as a principle."*

A note cannot stop anything. So the plan is now a **file whose presence is the permission**, exactly
like the kill switch: one ``stat`` per gate check, no tooling needed to satisfy it, and nothing to
forget. Without today's plan the mode gate fails and no broker order is sent; positions already open are
still managed, because refusing to manage them would be more dangerous than the missing plan.

**The day is the owner's trading day, 07:00 Thai to 07:00 Thai**, not the calendar date: a plan written
on Tuesday morning still covers Wednesday 02:00 Thai, in the middle of the New York session.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from datetime import datetime, time, timedelta
from pathlib import Path
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

TH = ZoneInfo("Asia/Bangkok")
DAY_STARTS = time(7)  # the owner's trading day opens with the Asia window
DEFAULT_DIR = Path("data/plans")
READ_LIMIT = 64 * 1024  # enough to tell prose from an empty file

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def trading_date(now: datetime) -> str:
    """The Thai trading day ``now`` belongs to, as ``YYYY-MM-DD``.

    02:00 Thai on Wednesday is still Tuesday's trading day; 07:00 Thai starts the new one.
    """
    th = now.astimezone(TH)
    return (th.date() - timedelta(days=1) if th.time() < DAY_STARTS else th.date()).isoformat()


class DayPlan:
    """Is today's plan written? Presence of the file is the whole answer."""

    def __init__(self, directory: Path | str = DEFAULT_DIR) -> None:
        self.directory = Path(directory)

    def path(self, now: datetime) -> Path:
        return self.directory / f"{trading_date(now)}.md"

    def exists(self, now: datetime) -> bool:
        """True when the day's plan file is there and not empty.

        An empty file is not a plan: a shell redirect that failed halfway would otherwise open the gate,
        and nor is one holding only whitespace (developer session, 2026-10-27).
        """
        p = self.path(now)
        try:
            if not p.is_file():
                return False
            with p.open("rb") as fh:  # bounded: a plan is prose, and a huge file must not be inhaled
                head = fh.read(READ_LIMIT)
            return bool(head.decode("utf-8").strip())
        except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError):
            # Anything unreadable - a vanished mount, no permission, bytes that are not text - is the
            # same as no plan. A decode error used to escape as an exception rather than a DAY_PLAN
            # refusal (developer session, 2026-10-27): the gate must say why it refused, not crash.
            log.warning("cannot read the day plan at %s; treating the day as unplanned", p)
            return False

    def write(self, now: datetime, text: str) -> Path:
        """Record the day's plan. Refuses to overwrite one: a day has one plan, added to, not replaced."""
        p = self.path(now)
        if self.exists(now):
            raise FileExistsError(f"the plan for {trading_date(now)} is already written: {p}")
        p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        p.write_bytes(text.encode("utf-8"))
        log.info("the plan for %s is recorded (%s)", trading_date(now), p)
        return p
"""The day's plan, written by the AI trader before it trades (owner 2026-10-25, KB P26, checklist E8: "before
trading each day, look at the market - yesterday's support / resistance and key levels, the likely trend, the
opportunities, the side with the edge, where price may turn or go on - and summarise it to me"; "you need the
levels on the smaller frames to trade during the day too").

At the start of each of the owner's windows (Asia 07:00 Thai = the morning plan; London and New York = an
update with the day's own M15 / M5 levels so far) the watcher asks the same AI, on the same readings, for a
:class:`DayPlan`. The plan goes into the AI's journal (so every later decision reads it), into ``plans.jsonl``
and the raw files of the store, and its readiness check is the forest items of the decision checklist answered
for the day plus the code's own facts. One code path for the replay and the engine (PLAN Â§A37).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Literal

import pandas as pd
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.ai.providers import AIProvider
from app.ai.trader import EFFORT, MIN_TAKE_PROFIT, TH, CheckAnswer, rule_vetoes, system_prompt
from app.core.enums import Side
from app.strategy import behaviors as bh
from app.strategy import knowledge as kn
from app.strategy import liquidity as lq
from app.strategy.ai_lane import AIOrder
from app.strategy.checklist import ITEMS, KINDS
from app.strategy.readout import reader_lines

Kind = Literal["morning", "london", "ny"]
KIND_OF_SESSION: dict[str, Kind] = {"asia": "morning", "london": "london", "ny": "ny"}
FOREST = tuple(k for k in ITEMS if k.startswith("A"))  # the day's readiness: the forest items A1 .. A8
READINGS = (
    "price", "d1_big", "d1_regime", "d1_rhythm", "h4_trend", "h4_rhythm", "h1_trend", "h1_rhythm",
    "m15_rhythm", "phase", "yesterday", "h1_vol", "h1_atr", "d1_atr20", "release_min", "runaway", "session",
    "asia_break",
)  # fmt: skip


class Level(BaseModel):
    price: float
    frame: Literal["D1", "H4", "H1", "M15", "M5"]
    role: Literal["support", "resistance", "both"]
    what: str = Field(description="what the level is, e.g. yesterday's high, M15 equal lows x3, round 4,200")


class Scenario(BaseModel):
    name: str = Field(description="A, B, C ...")
    side: Literal["BUY", "SELL"]
    where: Literal["turn", "go on"] = Field(description="a turn at a level, or the move going on through it")
    entry: float | None = Field(
        description="the price where this trade is entered: a pending order sits there, and the AI is woken "
        "when price arrives"
    )
    trigger: str = Field(
        description="ONE price event at the entry - price reaching it (a pending order), or one M1 / M5 "
        "close back across the level (e.g. an M5 close back under 4,195) - never a chain of confirmations "
        "(L20)"
    )
    stop: float | None = Field(description="past the liquidate zone beyond the structure")
    take_profit: float | None = Field(
        description="the next swing, >= 5 USD, short of the next main line's band"
    )
    why: str


class DayPlan(BaseModel):
    condition: str = Field(
        description="the market now: the D1 side, the H4 / H1 trend, volatility, the phase"
    )
    big_levels: list[Level] = Field(
        description="support / resistance on D1 / H4 / H1 and yesterday's: its high / low, strong levels, "
        "zone lines with their bands, round numbers"
    )
    intraday_levels: list[Level] = Field(
