        "highs / lows, the Asia range, volume nodes - the nearest ones above and below price"
    )
    trend_today: str = Field(description="the likely path today and why")
    opportunities: list[str] = Field(description="the trades the day may offer, in the owner's windows")
    edge_side: Literal["BUY", "SELL", "both", "none"] = Field(
        description="the side with the edge today (both: each at its own level)"
    )
    edge_why: str
    scenarios: list[Scenario] = Field(description="the points where price may turn or go on")
    releases: str = Field(description="today's scheduled releases and the windows")
    readiness: list[CheckAnswer] = Field(
        description="the forest items A1 .. A8 of the decision checklist answered for the day"
    )
    summary_th: str = Field(description="the plan in at most six short lines of Thai, for the owner")


TASK = {
    "morning": "THE MORNING PLAN (P26): before trading the day, write the day's plan (D1 names the side with "
    "the edge; H4 / H1 against it is a pullback whose end is the trade, L21)",
    "london": "THE LONDON UPDATE (P26): before the London window, update the day's plan",
    "ny": "THE NEW YORK UPDATE (P26): before the New York window, update the day's plan",
}


def plan_due(now: pd.Timestamp, last: str | None) -> Kind | None:
    """The plan due at ``now``: the window ``now`` is in, once a Thai day (``last`` = 'YYYY-MM-DD:kind')."""
    kind = KIND_OF_SESSION.get(kn.session(now))
    if kind is None:
        return None
    key = f"{now.tz_convert(TH):%Y-%m-%d}:{kind}"
    return None if key == last else kind


def plan_key(now: pd.Timestamp, kind: Kind) -> str:
    return f"{now.tz_convert(TH):%Y-%m-%d}:{kind}"


def plan_inputs(fr: kn.Frames, as_of: pd.Timestamp) -> tuple[str, dict[str, Any]]:
    """What the plan is written from (bars closed by ``as_of``): the readings, yesterday's and today's own
    levels, the readers' lines, the liquidity map (the stop side) and today's releases."""
    f = kn.features(fr, as_of)
    th = as_of.tz_convert(TH)
    start = pd.Timestamp(f"{th.date()} 07:00", tz=TH).tz_convert("UTC")
    # the previous trading day (Friday's on a Monday): its last M15 bar before today's 05:00 Thai
    before = fr.m15[fr.m15.index + pd.Timedelta(minutes=15) <= start - pd.Timedelta(hours=2)]
    prev_end = before.index[-1] + pd.Timedelta(minutes=15) if len(before) else start
    # day_levels' own D1 line there is the bar BEFORE that day: name the last closed D1 bar explicitly instead
    yesterday = [x for x in bh.day_levels(fr.m15, fr.d1, prev_end) if not x.startswith("yesterday's D1")]
    d1_done = fr.d1[fr.d1.index + pd.Timedelta(days=1) <= as_of]
    if len(d1_done):
        b = d1_done.iloc[-1]
        named = d1_done.index[-1] + pd.Timedelta(hours=12)  # the broker's day: its bar opens 21:00 UTC before
        yesterday.append(
            f"the last closed D1 bar ({named:%a %d %b}): high {b.high:.2f}, low {b.low:.2f}, "
            f"close {b.close:.2f}"
        )
    today = bh.day_levels(fr.m15, fr.d1, as_of) if as_of > start else []
    m5 = kn.m5_frame(fr.m1, as_of)
    liq = lq.liquidity_lines(fr.m1, m5, fr.m15, fr.h1, fr.d1, as_of)
    day_end = start + pd.Timedelta(days=1)
    rel = [x for x in fr.releases if start <= pd.Timestamp(x.at) < day_end]
    readings = {k: (round(v, 3) if isinstance(v, float) else v) for k, v in f.items() if k in READINGS}
    parts = [
        f"NOW: {th:%a %d %b %Y %H:%M} Thai time. Bars closed by this time only.",
        "READINGS:\n" + json.dumps(readings),
        "YESTERDAY'S OWN LEVELS (the previous Thai day):\n" + ("\n".join(yesterday) or "(none)"),
        "TODAY'S OWN LEVELS SO FAR (M15 swings, the day's high / low):\n"
        + ("\n".join(today) or "(none yet)"),
        "THE READERS' OUTPUT (rhythm per frame, pictures, the zone plan, strong levels):\n"
        + "\n".join(reader_lines(fr, as_of)),
        "THE LIQUIDITY MAP (liquidate zones - the stop side, never take-profit points):\n" + "\n".join(liq),
        "TODAY'S SCHEDULED US RELEASES (Thai time):\n"
        + (
            "\n".join(f"{pd.Timestamp(x.at).tz_convert(TH):%H:%M} {getattr(x, 'name', '')}" for x in rel)
            or "none"
        ),
        "THE OWNER'S WINDOWS: Asia 07:00-09:00, London 13:00-15:00 Thai, New York 08:00-11:30 New York time.",
    ]
    return "\n\n".join(parts), f


def readiness_facts(f: dict[str, Any], as_of: pd.Timestamp, fr: kn.Frames) -> list[str]:
    """The code's own readiness facts for the day: the bars' freshness, volatility (R01), releases (R07)."""
    closed = fr.m1.index[fr.m1.index + pd.Timedelta(minutes=1) <= as_of]
    last = closed[-1] + pd.Timedelta(minutes=1) if len(closed) else None
    fresh = last is not None and (as_of - last) <= pd.Timedelta(minutes=5)
    vol = f.get("h1_vol")
    return [
        f"bars current: {'yes' if fresh else 'NO'} (the last M1 close {last})",
        f"volatility (R01): h1_vol {vol:.2f} - {'stand aside' if vol > 1.1 else 'tradable'}"
        if isinstance(vol, float)
        else "volatility (R01): no reading",
        f"the nearest US release: {f.get('release_min')} minutes away (R07 within 60)",
    ]


def plan_markdown(plan: DayPlan, as_of: pd.Timestamp, kind: Kind, facts: list[str]) -> str:
    """The plan as the journal section the AI reads at every later step (and the owner reads)."""
    th = as_of.tz_convert(TH)
    title = {"morning": "the morning plan", "london": "the London update", "ny": "the New York update"}[kind]

    def lv(x: Level) -> str:
        return f"{x.price:.2f} {x.frame} {x.role} ({x.what})"

    lines = [
        f"## {th:%a %d %b %Y} - {title} ({th:%H:%M} Thai, written by the AI, P26)",
        f"- condition: {plan.condition}",
        "- big levels: " + "; ".join(lv(x) for x in plan.big_levels),
        "- intraday levels (M15 / M5): " + "; ".join(lv(x) for x in plan.intraday_levels),
        f"- the trend today: {plan.trend_today}",
        f"- the side with the edge: {plan.edge_side} - {plan.edge_why}",
    ]
    for s in plan.scenarios:
        lines.append(
            f"- {s.name} ({s.side}, {s.where}): {s.trigger}; stop {s.stop}, take-profit {s.take_profit} - "
            f"{s.why}"
        )
    lines.append("- opportunities: " + "; ".join(plan.opportunities))
    lines.append(f"- releases / windows: {plan.releases}")
    fails = [a.item for a in plan.readiness if a.verdict == "fail"]
    lines.append(f"- readiness (A1-A8): failed {', '.join(fails) or 'none'}; " + "; ".join(facts))
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"


def window_end(as_of: pd.Timestamp, kind: Kind) -> pd.Timestamp:
    """The end of the window a plan is written for: 09:00 / 15:00 Thai, 11:30 New York."""
    if kind == "ny":
        ny = as_of.tz_convert("America/New_York")
        return pd.Timestamp(f"{ny.date()} 11:30", tz="America/New_York").tz_convert("UTC")
    th = as_of.tz_convert(TH)
    return pd.Timestamp(f"{th.date()} {'09:00' if kind == 'morning' else '15:00'}", tz=TH).tz_convert("UTC")


def next_release(fr: kn.Frames, as_of: pd.Timestamp) -> str | None:
    """The next scheduled US release after ``as_of`` (ISO), None without one."""
    later = sorted(pd.Timestamp(x.at) for x in fr.releases if pd.Timestamp(x.at) > as_of)
    return later[0].isoformat() if later else None


def plan_orders(rec: dict[str, Any]) -> list[AIOrder]:
    """The plan's scenarios as pending orders, placed in advance and checked by the code (owner 2026-10-25:
    every planned trade of 06-07 Jul printed and none was taken): an entry, stop and take-profit point each;
    the stop moved out to the map's stop past the liquidate zone when nearer (C4); the take-profit point 5 USD
    or more from the entry (C5); no side a rule in force stops now (R01 / R07 / R09 ...); none against the D1
    regime (owner 2026-10-26: a trend needs the stop orders with it); half size."""
    plan = rec.get("plan")
    if plan is None:
        return []
    at = pd.Timestamp(rec["as_of"]).to_pydatetime()
    until = pd.Timestamp(rec["valid_until"]).to_pydatetime()
    if rec.get("next_release"):  # R07: an hour either side of a release is the news weapon's alone
        until = min(until, (pd.Timestamp(rec["next_release"]) - pd.Timedelta(minutes=60)).to_pydatetime())
    if until <= at:
        return []
    stops = rec.get("map_stops") or {}
    d1 = rec.get("d1_side", "none")  # the side with the edge (owner 10-20: D1 names it)
    out = []
    for s in plan["scenarios"]:
        side, entry, stop, tp = s["side"], s.get("entry"), s.get("stop"), s.get("take_profit")
        if entry is None or stop is None or tp is None or (rec.get("vetoes") or {}).get(side):
            continue
        sell = side == "SELL"
        if (sell and d1 == "up") or (not sell and d1 == "down"):
            continue  # against D1: 06-08 Jul, 5 of the 7 counter-D1 plan orders lost (-3.8 R); L21
        if stops.get(side) is not None:  # never inside the liquidate zone: out to the map's stop at least
            stop = max(stop, stops[side]) if sell else min(stop, stops[side])
        if (stop - entry if sell else entry - stop) <= 0 or abs(tp - entry) < MIN_TAKE_PROFIT:
            continue
        if (entry - tp if sell else tp - entry) <= 0:
            continue
        out.append(
            AIOrder(
                side=Side.SELL if sell else Side.BUY,
                entry=float(entry),
                stop=float(stop),
                target=float(tp),
                risk_scale=0.5,
                setup=f"plan {rec['kind']} {s['name']}: {s['trigger']}",
                reasons=(s["why"],),
                kb_ids=("P26",),
                confidence=0,
                decided_at=at,
                valid_until=until,
                key=f"plan-{rec['kind']}-{pd.Timestamp(rec['as_of']):%Y%m%d%H%M}-{s['name']}",
            )
        )
    return out


def make_plan(
    provider: AIProvider,
    entries: list[dict[str, Any]],
    fr: kn.Frames,
    as_of: pd.Timestamp,
    kind: Kind,
    *,
    model: str | None = None,
    store: Path | None = None,
    journal: Path | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Ask the AI for the plan due at ``as_of``; append it to ``journal`` and ``store``/plans.jsonl. Never
    raises on a failed answer: the record says so and nothing is appended to the journal."""
    inputs, f = plan_inputs(fr, as_of)
    forest = "\n".join(f"- {k} [{KINDS[k]}]: {ITEMS[k]}" for k in FOREST)
    user = (
        f"{TASK[kind]} - every heading of the plan, the levels on the big frames AND the M15 / M5 levels to "
        "trade during the day, each scenario with its trigger, stop (past the liquidate zone) and "
        "take-profit point (the next swing, >= 5 USD, short of the next main line's band), and the forest "
        f"items for the day:\n{forest}\n\n{inputs}"
    )
    system = system_prompt(entries)
    stem = f"{as_of.tz_convert(TH):%Y-%m-%d_%H%M}_plan_{kind}"
    if store is not None:
        raw = store / "raw"
        raw.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (raw / f"{stem}_2_user.txt").write_text(user, encoding="utf-8")
    ans = provider.ask(
        f"plan-{kind}-{as_of:%Y%m%d%H%M}",
        system,
        user,
        DayPlan,
        model=model,
        effort=EFFORT,
        cache_system=True,
    )
    rec: dict[str, Any] = {
        "as_of": as_of.isoformat(),
        "kind": kind,
        "status": ans.status.value,
        "model": ans.model,
        "cost_usd": ans.cost_usd,
        "latency_ms": ans.latency_ms,
        "detail": ans.detail,
    }
    if ans.parsed is not None:
        plan: DayPlan = ans.parsed
        facts = readiness_facts(f, as_of, fr)
        st = lq.structure_now(fr.m1, kn.m5_frame(fr.m1, as_of), fr.m15, fr.d1, fr.h1, as_of)
        rec.update(
            plan=plan.model_dump(),
            facts=facts,
            map_stops=None if st is None else {"SELL": st.sell_stop, "BUY": st.buy_stop},
            vetoes={s: rule_vetoes(entries, f, s) for s in ("BUY", "SELL")},
            valid_until=window_end(as_of, kind).isoformat(),
            next_release=next_release(fr, as_of),
            d1_side=f.get("d1_regime", "none"),
        )
        if journal is not None:
            journal.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            with journal.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
                fh.write("\n" + plan_markdown(plan, as_of, kind, facts))
    if store is not None:
        (store / "raw" / f"{stem}_3_answer.json").write_text(
            json.dumps(rec, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False), "utf-8"
        )
        with (store / "plans.jsonl").open("a", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            fh.write(json.dumps(rec, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
    return rec

"""The trading day's plan, as a gate rather than a reminder (P26).

The owner, 2026-10-25: every trading day starts with the plan - the market's condition, yesterday's
levels, the trend, the side with the edge, the turn/go-on scenarios - written and summarised before
anything is traded. It was recorded as a principle (P26), as a knowledge-base entry and as a memory, and
on the evening of 2026-10-27 the engine still opened a DEMO session with no plan at all. The owner:
*"I went to the trouble of telling you to write it down as a principle."*

A note cannot stop anything. So the plan is now a **file whose presence is the permission**, exactly
like the kill switch: one ``stat`` per gate check, no tooling needed to satisfy it, and nothing to
forget. Without today's plan the mode gate fails and no broker order is sent; positions already open are
still managed, because refusing to manage them would be more dangerous than the missing plan.

**The day is the owner's trading day, 07:00 Thai to 07:00 Thai**, not the calendar date: a plan written
on Tuesday morning still covers Wednesday 02:00 Thai, in the middle of the New York session.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from datetime import datetime, time, timedelta
from pathlib import Path
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

TH = ZoneInfo("Asia/Bangkok")
DAY_STARTS = time(7)  # the owner's trading day opens with the Asia window
DEFAULT_DIR = Path("data/plans")
READ_LIMIT = 64 * 1024  # enough to tell prose from an empty file

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def trading_date(now: datetime) -> str:
    """The Thai trading day ``now`` belongs to, as ``YYYY-MM-DD``.

    02:00 Thai on Wednesday is still Tuesday's trading day; 07:00 Thai starts the new one.
    """
    th = now.astimezone(TH)
    return (th.date() - timedelta(days=1) if th.time() < DAY_STARTS else th.date()).isoformat()


class DayPlan:
    """Is today's plan written? Presence of the file is the whole answer."""

    def __init__(self, directory: Path | str = DEFAULT_DIR) -> None:
        self.directory = Path(directory)

    def path(self, now: datetime) -> Path:
        return self.directory / f"{trading_date(now)}.md"

    def exists(self, now: datetime) -> bool:
        """True when the day's plan file is there and not empty.

        An empty file is not a plan: a shell redirect that failed halfway would otherwise open the gate,
        and nor is one holding only whitespace (developer session, 2026-10-27).
        """
        p = self.path(now)
        try:
            if not p.is_file():
                return False
            with p.open("rb") as fh:  # bounded: a plan is prose, and a huge file must not be inhaled
                head = fh.read(READ_LIMIT)
            return bool(head.decode("utf-8").strip())
        except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError):
            # Anything unreadable - a vanished mount, no permission, bytes that are not text - is the
            # same as no plan. A decode error used to escape as an exception rather than a DAY_PLAN
            # refusal (developer session, 2026-10-27): the gate must say why it refused, not crash.
            log.warning("cannot read the day plan at %s; treating the day as unplanned", p)
            return False

    def write(self, now: datetime, text: str) -> Path:
        """Record the day's plan. Refuses to overwrite one: a day has one plan, added to, not replaced."""
        p = self.path(now)
        if self.exists(now):
            raise FileExistsError(f"the plan for {trading_date(now)} is already written: {p}")
        p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        p.write_bytes(text.encode("utf-8"))
        log.info("the plan for %s is recorded (%s)", trading_date(now), p)
        return p
"""The trading day's plan as a gate (P26).

The owner recorded "every trading day starts with its plan" as a principle on 2026-10-25, it went into
the knowledge base and into a memory, and on the evening of 2026-10-27 the engine still opened a DEMO
session without one. These cases exist because a note cannot refuse anything and a gate can.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from app.risk.day_plan import TH, DayPlan, trading_date


def at(hour: int, minute: int = 0, day: int = 27) -> datetime:
    """A moment given in Thai time, returned in UTC as the engine's clock hands it over."""
    return datetime(2026, 10, day, hour, minute, tzinfo=TH).astimezone(UTC)


class TestTheTradingDay:
    """07:00 Thai to 07:00 Thai, so a plan written on Tuesday morning still covers Wednesday's NY hours."""

    def test_the_day_turns_at_seven_in_the_morning_thai(self) -> None:
        assert trading_date(at(6, 59)) == "2026-10-26"  # still the previous trading day
        assert trading_date(at(7, 0)) == "2026-10-27"  # the Asia window opens the new one
        assert trading_date(at(23, 30)) == "2026-10-27"
        assert trading_date(at(2, 0, day=28)) == "2026-10-27"  # the middle of New York

    def test_it_reads_the_thai_clock_whatever_zone_the_moment_arrives_in(self) -> None:
        # 00:30 UTC on the 28th is 07:30 Thai: past the turn, so it is the 28th
        assert trading_date(datetime(2026, 10, 28, 0, 30, tzinfo=UTC)) == "2026-10-28"
        # 23:00 UTC on the 27th is 06:00 Thai on the 28th: BEFORE the turn, so still the 27th
        assert trading_date(datetime(2026, 10, 27, 23, 0, tzinfo=UTC)) == "2026-10-27"


class TestThePlanFile:
    def test_no_file_means_the_day_is_unplanned(self, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
        assert DayPlan(tmp_path).exists(at(9)) is False

    def test_a_written_plan_opens_the_day(self, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
        plan = DayPlan(tmp_path)
        plan.write(at(6, 30), "the condition, the levels, the scenarios")
        assert plan.exists(at(6, 30)) is True

    def test_an_empty_file_is_not_a_plan(self, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
        # a redirect that failed halfway would otherwise open the gate
        plan = DayPlan(tmp_path)
        plan.path(at(9)).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        plan.path(at(9)).write_bytes(b"")
        assert plan.exists(at(9)) is False

    def test_yesterdays_plan_does_not_cover_today(self, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
        plan = DayPlan(tmp_path)
        plan.write(at(9, day=26), "yesterday's plan")
        assert plan.exists(at(9, day=26)) is True
        assert plan.exists(at(9, day=27)) is False

    def test_a_plan_written_in_the_morning_still_covers_the_new_york_hours(self, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
        plan = DayPlan(tmp_path)
        plan.write(at(7, 15), "written as the Asia window opens")
        assert plan.exists(at(2, 0, day=28)) is True  # 02:00 Thai the next morning, mid New York

    def test_a_plan_written_before_seven_is_filed_under_the_day_before(self, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
        """A trap worth a test: 06:45 Thai is still yesterday's trading day, so a plan written then
        does NOT open the day that is about to start. Write it at or after 07:00."""
        plan = DayPlan(tmp_path)
        plan.write(at(6, 45), "too early")
        assert plan.path(at(6, 45)).name == "2026-10-26.md"
        assert plan.exists(at(9)) is False  # 09:00 Thai on the 27th is still unplanned

    def test_a_day_is_not_replanned_over_the_top_of_itself(self, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
        plan = DayPlan(tmp_path)
        plan.write(at(7), "the first plan")
        with pytest.raises(FileExistsError):
            plan.write(at(20), "a second, convenient one")
        assert plan.path(at(7)).read_text(encoding="utf-8") == "the first plan"


class TestTheGapsTheReviewFound:
    """Added after the developer session planted bugs in `day_plan.py` on 2026-10-27 and found four
    contracts that no case asserted: the boundary's direction, "a file, not a directory", the folder
    being created, and the unreadable-path branch. 10 of its 14 mutations were caught before these."""

    def test_the_boundary_faces_the_right_way(self) -> None:
        # flipping `< 07:00` to `> 07:00` passed every earlier case: they only asked that two instants
        # differ, never which trading date each one belongs to
        assert trading_date(at(6, 59)) == "2026-10-26"
        assert trading_date(at(7, 1)) == "2026-10-27"
        assert trading_date(at(12, 0)) == "2026-10-27"

    def test_a_directory_with_the_plan_s_name_is_not_a_plan(self, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
        plan = DayPlan(tmp_path)
        plan.path(at(9)).mkdir(parents=True)  # `is_file()` is what keeps this out
        assert plan.exists(at(9)) is False

    def test_a_file_of_whitespace_is_not_a_plan(self, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
        plan = DayPlan(tmp_path)
        plan.path(at(9)).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        plan.path(at(9)).write_bytes(b"   \n\t\n")
        assert plan.exists(at(9)) is False

    def test_writing_creates_the_folder_and_hands_back_where_it_went(self, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
        plan = DayPlan(tmp_path / "nested" / "plans")
        written = plan.write(at(8), "the plan")
        assert written == plan.path(at(8)) and written.is_file()

    def test_an_unreadable_path_counts_as_unplanned(self, tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch) -> None:  # type: ignore[no-untyped-def]
        plan = DayPlan(tmp_path)
        plan.write(at(8), "the plan")

        def boom(*_a: object, **_k: object) -> object:
            raise OSError("the mount went away")

        monkeypatch.setattr(Path, "open", boom)  # exists() reads a bounded head, not read_text
        assert plan.exists(at(8)) is False  # fail closed, never "assume it is fine"

    def test_a_moment_given_in_a_third_timezone_reads_the_same(self) -> None:
        from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

        ny = datetime(2026, 10, 27, 9, 0, tzinfo=ZoneInfo("America/New_York"))  # 20:00 Thai
        assert trading_date(ny) == "2026-10-27"
        early = datetime(2026, 10, 26, 19, 30, tzinfo=ZoneInfo("America/New_York"))  # 06:30 Thai on the 27th
        assert trading_date(early) == "2026-10-26"


def test_a_plan_that_is_not_text_counts_as_unplanned(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    """Invalid UTF-8 used to escape as an exception instead of a DAY_PLAN refusal: the gate must be able
    to say why it refused (developer session, 2026-10-27)."""
    plan = DayPlan(tmp_path)
    plan.path(at(9)).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    plan.path(at(9)).write_bytes(b"\xff\xfe not text at all")

def test_a_very_large_plan_is_not_read_whole(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    from app.risk.day_plan import READ_LIMIT

    plan = DayPlan(tmp_path)
    plan.path(at(9)).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    plan.path(at(9)).write_bytes(b"x" * (READ_LIMIT * 4))

"""Hand-worked H4 lean cases, from close-stamped H1 candles.

The rule measured and frozen on 2026-10-27 (`research/2026-10-26-three-bots/RULES_LOCKED.md`, rule set 2)
is a QUANTITY on the H4 frame, not a D1 label: the close's distance from its own 50-bar mean in its own
14-bar ATR, signed. An earlier version of this module read a D1 regime label; the measurement put D1
last of the three frames (+0.030 against H4's +0.156 correlation with the trade's R).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime

import pandas as pd
import pytest

from app.core.enums import Side, Timeframe
from app.indicators.volatility import atr
from app.strategy import edge_side as module
from app.strategy.edge_side import ATR_BARS, MEAN_BARS, behind, edge_lean, edge_side, resample_from_h1

NEEDED = MEAN_BARS + ATR_BARS  # 64 closed H4 bars


def h1_frame(h4_closes: list[float], *, spread: float = 1.0, forming: float | None = None):
    """H1 candles, CLOSE-stamped as the app's frames are, that resample into the given H4 closes.

    Each H4 bar is four H1 bars: the first three sit at the previous close so the H4 close is the value
    asked for, and every bar spans ``spread`` so the ATR is predictable.
    """
    closes: list[float] = []
    for i, value in enumerate(h4_closes):
        previous = h4_closes[i - 1] if i else value
        closes += [previous, previous, previous, value]
    if forming is not None:
        closes += [forming]  # one extra H1 bar: the H4 bar it belongs to has not closed
    # the first H1 bar CLOSES at 01:00, so it opens at 00:00 and its H4 bar opens at 00:00 too
    index = pd.date_range(datetime(2026, 1, 1, 1, tzinfo=UTC), periods=len(closes), freq="1h")
    frame = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "open": closes,
            "high": [c + spread / 2 for c in closes],
            "low": [c - spread / 2 for c in closes],
            "close": closes,
        },
        index=index,
    )
    return {Timeframe.H1: frame}, pd.Timestamp(frame.index[-1])


def expected_lean(frames, at) -> float:
    """The same number worked out from the resampled frame, independently of the function under test."""
    bars = resample_from_h1(frames[Timeframe.H1], 4)
    closed = bars[(bars.index + pd.Timedelta(hours=4)) <= at]
    mean = closed.close.rolling(MEAN_BARS).mean().iloc[-1]
    width = atr(closed.high, closed.low, closed.close, ATR_BARS).iloc[-1]
    return float((closed.close.iloc[-1] - mean) / width)


class TestTheLean:
    def test_a_rising_frame_leans_up_and_a_falling_one_leans_down(self):
        up, at_up = h1_frame([100.0 + i for i in range(NEEDED)])
        down, at_down = h1_frame([100.0 - i for i in range(NEEDED)])
        assert edge_lean(up, at_up, Timeframe.M5) > 0
        assert edge_lean(down, at_down, Timeframe.M5) < 0

    def test_a_flat_frame_leans_neither_way(self):
        frames, at = h1_frame([100.0] * NEEDED)
        assert edge_lean(frames, at, Timeframe.M5) == pytest.approx(0.0)
        assert edge_side(frames, at, Timeframe.M5) is None  # exactly zero is on neither side

    def test_the_number_is_the_distance_from_the_mean_in_atrs(self):
        frames, at = h1_frame([100.0 + i for i in range(NEEDED)])
        assert edge_lean(frames, at, Timeframe.M5) == pytest.approx(expected_lean(frames, at))

    def test_a_bar_that_has_not_closed_is_not_read(self):
        # the forming H4 bar carries a huge close; reading it would swamp a flat 64-bar history
        flat, at = h1_frame([100.0] * NEEDED)
        with_forming, at_forming = h1_frame([100.0] * NEEDED, forming=10_000.0)
        assert edge_lean(with_forming, at_forming, Timeframe.M5) == pytest.approx(
            edge_lean(flat, at, Timeframe.M5)
        )

    def test_too_little_history_is_no_answer_rather_than_a_guess(self):
        frames, at = h1_frame([100.0 + i for i in range(NEEDED - 1)])
        assert edge_lean(frames, at, Timeframe.M5) is None
        assert edge_side(frames, at, Timeframe.M5) is None

    def test_a_missing_h1_frame_is_no_answer(self):
        assert edge_lean({}, pd.Timestamp("2026-01-01", tz="UTC"), Timeframe.M5) is None


class TestTheGuardrails:
    def test_the_frame_read_must_be_larger_than_the_entry_frame(self):
        frames, at = h1_frame([100.0] * NEEDED)
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="must be smaller"):
            edge_lean(frames, at, Timeframe.H4)  # the rule is meaningless read on the entry frame
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="must be smaller"):
            edge_lean(frames, at, Timeframe.D1, frame=Timeframe.H4)

    def test_h1_and_d1_can_be_read_too_so_the_frame_can_be_re_measured(self):
        frames, at = h1_frame([100.0 + i for i in range(NEEDED * 7)])
        assert edge_lean(frames, at, Timeframe.M5, frame=Timeframe.H1) is not None
        assert edge_lean(frames, at, Timeframe.M5, frame=Timeframe.D1) is not None


class TestBehind:
    def test_a_buy_wants_the_lean_up_and_a_sell_wants_it_down(self):
        assert behind(1.5, Side.BUY) == 1.5
        assert behind(1.5, Side.SELL) == -1.5
        assert behind(-1.5, Side.SELL) == 1.5

    def test_no_lean_stays_no_lean(self):
        assert behind(None, Side.BUY) is None


class TestTheSideShortcut:
    def test_it_follows_the_sign_of_the_lean(self):
        up, at_up = h1_frame([100.0 + i for i in range(NEEDED)])
        down, at_down = h1_frame([100.0 - i for i in range(NEEDED)])
        assert edge_side(up, at_up, Timeframe.M5) is Side.BUY
        assert edge_side(down, at_down, Timeframe.M5) is Side.SELL


class TestNothingNonFiniteEscapes:
    """`nan < 0` is False, so a NaN lean would sail through a gate written as "refuse when negative" and
    open a trade on no evidence. Found by the developer session reviewing this gate while it was live on
    the DEMO account (2026-10-27); it was right, and the gate was switched off until this was closed."""

    def test_a_non_finite_width_gives_no_lean(self, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch):
        # the guard is tested directly: the data that would reach it is hard to build on purpose, because
        # the resample drops NaN buckets and the ATR's first true range is NaN anyway - two accidental
        # defences that this test must not be allowed to hide behind
        frames, at = h1_frame([100.0 + i for i in range(NEEDED)])
        assert edge_lean(frames, at, Timeframe.M5) is not None  # finite before the ruler is broken
        for bad in (float("inf"), float("nan")):
            monkeypatch.setattr(module, "atr", lambda *_a, bad=bad, **_k: pd.Series([bad] * 200))
            assert edge_lean(frames, at, Timeframe.M5) is None, bad

    def test_a_non_finite_mean_gives_no_lean(self, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch):
        frames, at = h1_frame([100.0 + i for i in range(NEEDED)])
        h1 = frames[Timeframe.H1]
        # an infinite CLOSE inside the last 50 H4 buckets (bucket 60 = H1 bars 240-243): inf survives the
        # dropna, unlike NaN, and poisons the 50-bar mean. Bucket 10 would not - it is outside the window.
        h1.iloc[243, h1.columns.get_loc("close")] = float("inf")
        assert edge_lean(frames, at, Timeframe.M5) is None

    def test_a_zero_width_frame_gives_no_lean(self):
        # every bar identical: the ATR is 0, so the distance in ATRs is not a number
        frames, at = h1_frame([100.0] * NEEDED, spread=0.0)
        assert edge_lean(frames, at, Timeframe.M5) is None


def test_the_h4_buckets_are_hand_worked_without_the_production_resampler():
    """The developer session called `expected_lean` partly circular: it reuses `resample_from_h1`, so it
    cannot prove the one-hour shift is in the right direction. This checks the timestamps by hand.

    App H1 bars are stamped at the CLOSE. A bar stamped 01:00 covers 00:00-01:00 and belongs to the H4
    bar that OPENS at 00:00 and CLOSES at 04:00. So the four bars stamped 01:00, 02:00, 03:00, 04:00 are
    one H4 bar, indexed 00:00, and it may not be read before 04:00.
    """
    closes = pd.date_range(datetime(2026, 3, 2, 1, tzinfo=UTC), periods=8, freq="1h")  # 01:00 .. 08:00
    h1 = pd.DataFrame(
        {"open": 10.0, "high": [11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18.0], "low": 9.0, "close": 10.0}, index=closes
    )
    bars = resample_from_h1(h1, 4)
    assert list(bars.index) == [
        pd.Timestamp("2026-03-02 00:00", tz="UTC"),
        pd.Timestamp("2026-03-02 04:00", tz="UTC"),
    ]
    # the first H4 bar holds the H1 bars stamped 01:00-04:00, whose highs are 11, 12, 13, 14
    assert list(bars.high) == [14.0, 18.0]
    # and it is readable at 04:00, not a minute before
    assert bars.index[0] + pd.Timedelta(hours=4) == pd.Timestamp("2026-03-02 04:00", tz="UTC")


def test_a_tiny_atr_overflows_to_infinity_and_is_refused(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch):
    """The developer session was right and I was wrong (2026-10-27).

    I wrote that the final `isfinite` guard was unreachable, because the mean and width guards stop every
    non-finite input. They do - but a FINITE, positive, tiny ATR (1e-320) passes both and then overflows
    the division to infinity. `inf < 0` is False, so a gate written as "refuse when the lean is negative"
    would open on no evidence at all. The guard is live code, and this is the input that reaches it.
    """
    frames, at = h1_frame([100.0 + i for i in range(NEEDED)])
    monkeypatch.setattr(module, "atr", lambda *_a, **_k: pd.Series([1e-320] * 200))
    assert edge_lean(frames, at, Timeframe.M5) is None
"""Setup OWN PLAN-1 as the ``plan1`` lane (app/strategy/plan1.py): the London ORB on closed M1 bars and the NY
08:30 straddle every weekday. Every expected number is worked by hand in the comments."""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, date, datetime, timedelta

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from pydantic import ValidationError

from app.core.enums import Action, ExitReason, Side, Timeframe
from app.news.releases import Release

from app.strategy.catalog import default_registry

    DailyStraddle,

    Plan1Straddle,
    Plan1StraddleParams,
    broken_pools,

    h1_atr_at,

    pools,

from app.strategy.signal_models import MarketContext, OpenPosition, ReasonCode, StrategyContext

T0 = pd.Timestamp("2026-09-30 06:00", tz="UTC")  # Wednesday, 13:00 Thai: the London ORB's open


def utc(text: str) -> pd.Timestamp:
    return pd.Timestamp(text, tz="UTC")


def frame(
    start: str, end_open: str, *, o: float = 4000.0, half: float = 5.0, special: dict | None = None
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """M1 bars opening every minute from *start* to *end_open* (both included): open = close = *o*, high / low
    *o* +- *half*; *special*: open time -> (open, high, low, close)."""
    opens = pd.date_range(utc(start), utc(end_open), freq="1min")
    df = pd.DataFrame(
        {"open": o, "high": o + half, "low": o - half, "close": o, "spread": 30.0},
        index=opens,
    )
    for at, (a, b, c, d) in (special or {}).items():
        df.loc[utc(at), ["open", "high", "low", "close"]] = [a, b, c, d]
    df.insert(0, "open_time", df.index)
    df.index = df.index + pd.Timedelta(minutes=1)  # indexed by the close time, as the context builder does
    return df


def h1_days(ranges: list[float], first: str = "2026-09-01", close: float = 4000.0) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """H1 bars of consecutive server days (Athens midnight to midnight, 24 bars each): day k trades close +- ranges[k]
    / 2 and closes at *close*, so its true range is ranges[k]."""
    rows = []
    for k, r in enumerate(ranges):
        start = pd.Timestamp(first, tz="Europe/Athens") + pd.Timedelta(days=k)
        for hr in range(24):
            t = (start + pd.Timedelta(hours=hr)).tz_convert("UTC")
            rows.append((t, close, close + r / 2, close - r / 2, close))
    df = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=["open_time", "open", "high", "low", "close"])
    df.index = df.open_time + pd.Timedelta(hours=1)
    return df


def wide_h1(at: datetime | pd.Timestamp) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """30 days of 100-USD days before *at*: the D1 ATR(20) is 100 (the regime switch is on)."""
    day = pd.Timestamp(at).tz_convert("Europe/Athens").normalize() - pd.Timedelta(days=31)
    df = h1_days([100.0] * 31, f"{day:%Y-%m-%d}")
    return df[df.index <= pd.Timestamp(at)]


def arrays(df: pd.DataFrame) -> tuple[pd.DatetimeIndex, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    return plan1._m1_arrays(df)


# --- the H1 ATR ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


class TestH1Atr:
    @staticmethod
    def hours() -> pd.DataFrame:
        """16 hours from 00:00: hour i trades 100+i .. 102+i and closes 101+i (true range 2 against the
        previous close 100+i); hour 15 gaps up to 116 .. 120 from the previous close 115: true range 120 - 115
        = 5 (its high - low is only 4)."""
        rows = []
        for i in range(16):
            lo, hi, c = (116.0, 120.0, 118.0) if i == 15 else (100.0 + i, 102.0 + i, 101.0 + i)
            for m in range(60):
                rows.append((utc("2026-09-30") + pd.Timedelta(hours=i, minutes=m), c, hi, lo, c))
        df = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=["open_time", "open", "high", "low", "close"])
        df.index = df.open_time + pd.Timedelta(minutes=1)
        return df

    def test_mt5_atr_of_complete_hours(self) -> None:
        opens, _, h, lo, c = arrays(self.hours())
        # at 16:00 the last 14 true ranges are hours 2..15: (13 x 2 + 5) / 14
        assert h1_atr_at(opens, h, lo, c, utc("2026-09-30 16:00")) == pytest.approx(31 / 14)
        # hour 15 is not complete before 16:00: hours 1..14, all 2
        assert h1_atr_at(opens, h, lo, c, utc("2026-09-30 15:59")) == pytest.approx(2.0)
        # 14 complete hours give 13 true ranges: not ready
        assert np.isnan(h1_atr_at(opens, h, lo, c, utc("2026-09-30 14:00")))


# --- the opening range ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def orb_bars(**extra: tuple[float, float, float, float]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Flat 4000 +- 5 before 06:00; the range bars 06:00-06:14 at 4000 +- 1 with a high 4004 at 06:05 and a
    low 3998 at 06:10 (range 3998-4004, width 6); after it 4000 +- 1 unless *extra* says otherwise."""
    special = {f"2026-09-30 06:{m:02d}": (4000.0, 4001.0, 3999.0, 4000.0) for m in range(60)}
    special |= {"2026-09-30 06:05": (4000.0, 4004.0, 3999.0, 4000.0)}
    special |= {"2026-09-30 06:10": (4000.0, 4001.0, 3998.0, 4000.0)}
    special |= {f"2026-09-30 {k[1:3]}:{k[4:]}": v for k, v in extra.items()}
    return frame("2026-09-29 00:00", "2026-09-30 06:59", special=special)


class TestOrbDecide:
    P = Plan1OrbParams()

    def decide(self, df: pd.DataFrame, atr: float = 10.0) -> plan1.OrbDecision:
        opens, _, h, lo, c = arrays(df)
        return orb_decide(opens, h, lo, c, T0, atr, self.P)

    def test_the_first_close_beyond_the_range_is_the_trade(self) -> None:
        # 06:15 closes AT the high 4004 (not beyond); 06:16 closes 4004.5 > 4004: a buy at bar 06:16
        df = orb_bars(t06_15=(4003.0, 4004.0, 4002.0, 4004.0), t06_16=(4004.0, 4004.8, 4003.9, 4004.5))
        d = self.decide(df)
        assert (d.status, d.side, d.rh, d.rl) == ("trade", 1, 4004.0, 3998.0)
        assert df.open_time.iloc[d.k] == utc("2026-09-30 06:16")

    def test_a_sell_and_only_the_first_break_counts(self) -> None:
        # 06:20 closes 3997.9 < 3998 first; 06:30 closes above the high later: the day's trade is the sell
        df = orb_bars(t06_20=(3999.0, 3999.0, 3997.0, 3997.9), t06_30=(4004.0, 4006.0, 4004.0, 4005.0))
        d = self.decide(df)
        assert (d.status, d.side) == ("trade", -1)
        assert df.open_time.iloc[d.k] == utc("2026-09-30 06:20")

    def test_wide_range_late_open_and_no_break(self) -> None:
        df = orb_bars(t06_16=(4004.0, 4004.8, 4003.9, 4004.5))
        assert self.decide(df, atr=3.9).status == "wide"  # 6 > 1.5 x 3.9 = 5.85
        assert self.decide(df, atr=4.0).status == "trade"  # 6 <= 6.0
        assert self.decide(df, atr=float("nan")).status == "wide"  # unknown ATR: no trade (fail closed)
        assert self.decide(orb_bars()).status == "no_break"
        gap6 = df[(df.open_time < T0) | (df.open_time >= T0 + pd.Timedelta(minutes=6))]
        assert self.decide(gap6).status == "late_open"  # the first bar at 06:06: 6 > 5 minutes
        gap5 = df[(df.open_time < T0) | (df.open_time >= T0 + pd.Timedelta(minutes=5))]
        assert self.decide(gap5).status == "trade"  # 06:05 counts (<= 5 minutes)

    def test_a_break_after_the_entry_window_is_ignored(self) -> None:
        # the window is the 60 minutes after the range: bars opening 06:15 .. 07:14
        late = frame(
            "2026-09-29 00:00", "2026-09-30 07:20", special={"2026-09-30 07:15": (4000, 4010, 4000, 4009)}
        )
        late.loc[late.open_time.between(T0, T0 + pd.Timedelta(minutes=14)), ["high", "low"]] = [
            4004.0,
            3998.0,
        ]
        assert self.decide(late).status == "no_break"


# --- pools, pool breaks, the H4 ATR change ------------------------------------------------------------------


class TestPools:
    @staticmethod
    def bars() -> pd.DataFrame:
        """Flat 4000 +- 0.5 from 2026-09-28 20:00 UTC; server day 29th (EEST, from 09-28 21:00 UTC): a high
        4010 at 10:00 and a low 3990 at 12:00 UTC; the Asia range of the Thai 30th (09-29 17:00-24:00 UTC):
        a high 4007 at 19:00 and a low 3995 at 22:00; the server day 30th opens at 09-29 21:00 UTC at 4001
        (high 4001)."""
        return frame(
            "2026-09-28 20:00",
            "2026-09-30 06:16",
            half=0.5,
            special={
                "2026-09-29 10:00": (4000.0, 4010.0, 3999.5, 4000.0),
                "2026-09-29 12:00": (4000.0, 4000.5, 3990.0, 4000.0),
                "2026-09-29 19:00": (4000.0, 4007.0, 3999.5, 4000.0),
                "2026-09-29 21:00": (4001.0, 4001.0, 3999.5, 4000.0),
                "2026-09-29 22:00": (4000.0, 4000.5, 3995.0, 4000.0),
                # the 06:00 M15 bin rises above its left bin but its right (forming) bin rises further: no fractal
                "2026-09-30 06:05": (4000.0, 4003.0, 3997.0, 4000.0),
                "2026-09-30 06:16": (4000.0, 4005.0, 3996.0, 4000.0),
            },
        )

    def test_the_pools_at_the_decision(self) -> None:
        opens, o, h, lo, _ = arrays(self.bars())
        got = pools(opens, o, h, lo, utc("2026-09-30 06:17"))
        # yesterday = server day 29th; Asia = Thai 30th 00-07; today's open = the 21:00 UTC bar's open;
        # the last M15 fractals: the 21:00 bin's high 4001 (newer than 19:00's 4007), the 22:00 bin's low 3995;
        # the 06:00 bin (4003 / 3997) beats its left bin only - its right bin goes to 4005 / 3996: not a fractal
        assert got == {
            "yday_high": 4010.0,
            "yday_low": 3990.0,
            "asia_high": 4007.0,
            "asia_low": 3995.0,
            "today_open": 4001.0,
            "swing_high": 4001.0,
            "swing_low": 3995.0,
        }

    def test_a_monday_sees_fridays_high_and_low_and_the_asia_range_ends_at_07_thai(self) -> None:
        """Friday 2026-09-25 trades to 20:59 UTC (server day 25th) with a high 4012 and a low 3988; no bars on the
        weekend; Monday's server day opens Sunday 22:00 UTC. Monday 00:30 UTC (07:30 Thai) trades 4020 / 3980:
        after the Asia range (00:00-07:00 Thai = Sunday 17:00 .. Monday 00:00 UTC), so not in it."""
        fri = frame(
            "2026-09-25 00:00",
            "2026-09-25 20:59",
            half=0.5,
            special={
                "2026-09-25 10:00": (4000.0, 4012.0, 3999.5, 4000.0),
                "2026-09-25 12:00": (4000, 4000.5, 3988, 4000),
            },
        )
        mon = frame(
            "2026-09-27 22:00",
            "2026-09-28 06:16",
            half=0.5,
            special={
                "2026-09-27 23:00": (4000.0, 4006.0, 3999.5, 4000.0),
                "2026-09-28 00:30": (4000.0, 4020.0, 3980.0, 4000.0),
            },
        )
        opens, o, h, lo, _ = arrays(pd.concat([fri, mon]))
        got = pools(opens, o, h, lo, utc("2026-09-28 06:17"))
        assert (got["yday_high"], got["yday_low"]) == (4012.0, 3988.0)  # Friday, three days back
        assert (got["asia_high"], got["asia_low"]) == (4006.0, 3999.5)  # not the 07:30-Thai bar's 4020 / 3980

    def test_no_asia_range_before_07_thai_and_no_future_bars(self) -> None:
        df = self.bars()
        opens, o, h, lo, _ = arrays(df)
        got = pools(opens, o, h, lo, utc("2026-09-29 23:30"))  # 06:30 Thai: the Asia range is still open
        assert "asia_high" not in got and got["today_open"] == 4001.0
        # a spike after the decision changes nothing at the decision (no look-ahead)
        spiked = df.copy()
        spiked.loc[spiked.open_time == utc("2026-09-30 06:16"), "high"] = 5000.0
        o2, oo, hh, ll, _ = arrays(spiked)
        assert pools(o2, oo, hh, ll, utc("2026-09-30 06:16")) == pools(
            opens, o, h, lo, utc("2026-09-30 06:16")
        )

    def test_broken_pools_in_the_trade_direction(self) -> None:
        # the window = bars opening 06:02 .. 06:16 (15 minutes before 06:17): first open 4000, high 4004.5,
        # low 3999.5; the 06:01 bar (open 3990) is outside it
        df = frame(
            "2026-09-30 05:00",
            "2026-09-30 06:16",
            half=0.5,
            special={
                "2026-09-30 06:01": (3990.0, 3990.5, 3989.5, 3990.0),
                "2026-09-30 06:16": (4000.0, 4004.5, 3999.5, 4004.0),
            },
        )
        opens, o, h, lo, _ = arrays(df)
        found = {"a": 4002.0, "b": 4005.0, "c": 3999.8, "d": 3995.0, "e": 4000.0}
        at = utc("2026-09-30 06:17")
        # "e" sits at the window's first open 4000: opening AT a pool is not breaking it, either way
        assert broken_pools(opens, o, h, lo, at, 1, found) == ["a"]  # 4000 < 4002 < 4004.5
        assert broken_pools(opens, o, h, lo, at, -1, found) == ["c"]  # 4000 > 3999.8 > 3999.5
        # the bar opening exactly 15 minutes before the decision (06:02) is inside the window: its open 3990
        # is the window's first open, so a buy breaks 3995 too
        early = df.copy()
        early.loc[early.open_time == utc("2026-09-30 06:02"), ["open", "low"]] = [3990.0, 3989.5]
        o2, oo, hh, ll, _ = arrays(early)
        assert broken_pools(o2, oo, hh, ll, at, 1, found) == ["a", "c", "d", "e"]

    def test_contracting_is_the_journals_whole_percent_reading(self) -> None:
        # liq_journal rounds the change to a whole percent, rules_week skips at <= 0: +0.4 % is contracting
        assert plan1.is_contracting(0.004, 0.5) and plan1.is_contracting(0.005, 0.5)
        assert not plan1.is_contracting(0.006, 0.5) and not plan1.is_contracting(0.004, 0.0)
        assert plan1.is_contracting(-0.2, 0.5) and plan1.is_contracting(float("nan"), 0.5)

    def test_h4_bars_on_the_server_day_from_m1(self) -> None:
        """Wednesday 2026-09-30, EEST (UTC+3): the server's H4 bars open at 00:00 / 04:00 / 08:00 / 12:00 Athens =
        21:00 / 01:00 / 05:00 / 09:00 UTC. M1 bars 00:00-09:59 UTC at 4000 +- 1, a high of 4010 at 02:30 UTC: at
        10:00 UTC the bars closing 01:00 (partial: from 00:00 UTC), 05:00 (high 4010) and 09:00 are complete, the
        09:00-13:00 UTC one is running."""
        df = frame(
            "2026-09-30 00:00",
            "2026-09-30 09:59",
            half=1.0,
            special={"2026-09-30 02:30": (4000, 4010, 3999, 4000)},
        )
        opens, _, h, lo, c = arrays(df)
        h4 = plan1.h4_bars(opens, h, lo, c, utc("2026-09-30 10:00"))
        assert list(h4.index) == [utc("2026-09-30 01:00"), utc("2026-09-30 05:00"), utc("2026-09-30 09:00")]
        assert list(h4["high"]) == [4001.0, 4010.0, 4001.0] and list(h4["low"]) == [3999.0] * 3

    def test_h4_atr_change(self) -> None:
        """21 H4 bars of range 2 (closes flat), then the last 6 of range 4: ATR now (8 x 2 + 6 x 4) / 14,
        6 bars earlier 2: change 40 / 28 - 1."""
        closes = pd.date_range(utc("2026-09-20 04:00"), periods=27, freq="4h")
        rng = np.r_[np.full(21, 2.0), np.full(6, 4.0)]
        h4 = pd.DataFrame(
            {"open": 4000.0, "high": 4000 + rng / 2, "low": 4000 - rng / 2, "close": 4000.0}, index=closes
        )
        assert h4_atr_change(h4, closes[-1]) == pytest.approx(40 / 28 - 1)
        assert h4_atr_change(h4, closes[-7]) == pytest.approx(
            0.0
        )  # all range 2: no change (contracting: <= 0)
        assert h4_atr_change(h4, closes[-1] - pd.Timedelta(minutes=1)) == pytest.approx(
            (9 * 2 + 5 * 4) / 14 / 2 - 1
        )  # the last bar is not closed yet
        assert np.isnan(h4_atr_change(h4.iloc[:19], closes[18]))  # 19 bars < 14 + 6


# --- the ORB strategy -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def h4_frame(expanding: bool | None) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """H4 bars of range 6; the last six of range 8 (expanding), 4 (contracting) or 6 (None: no change)."""
    closes = pd.date_range(utc("2026-09-24 01:00"), utc("2026-09-30 05:00"), freq="4h")
    n = len(closes)
    rng = np.full(n, 6.0)
    rng[-6:] = 6.0 if expanding is None else 8.0 if expanding else 4.0
    return pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "open_time": closes - pd.Timedelta(hours=4),
            "open": 4000.0,
            "high": 4000 + rng / 2,
            "low": 4000 - rng / 2,
            "close": 4000.0,
        },
        index=closes,
    )


def orb_ctx(
    df: pd.DataFrame, *, expanding: bool | None = True, ask_over: float = 0.3, h4: bool = True
) -> StrategyContext:
    at = pd.Timestamp(df.index[-1]).to_pydatetime()
    close = float(df.close.iloc[-1])
    market = MarketContext(
        symbol="XAUUSD",
        decision_time_utc=at,
        entry_timeframe=Timeframe.M1,
        higher_timeframe=Timeframe.H4,
        states=(state(Timeframe.M1, at, close=close), state(Timeframe.H4, at, close=close)),
        bid=close,
        ask=close + ask_over,
        spread_points=ask_over / XAUUSD_SPEC.point,
    )
    frames = {Timeframe.M1: df, Timeframe.H4: h4_frame(expanding)} if h4 else {Timeframe.M1: df}
    return StrategyContext(market, {**frames, Timeframe.H1: wide_h1(at)}, at, XAUUSD_SPEC)


def upto(df: pd.DataFrame, close: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    return df[df.index <= utc(close)]


BREAK = {"t06_16": (4004.0, 4004.8, 4003.9, 4004.5)}


class TestRegimeSwitch:
    """The regime switch (journal, CHECKLIST row 62): new entries only while the D1 ATR(20) >= 60 USD; server days
    built from H1 bars; a day is known from its server midnight + 24 h."""

    END = pd.Timestamp("2026-09-21", tz="Europe/Athens").tz_convert(
        "UTC"
    )  # the midnight after day 20 (09-01 + 19)

    def test_the_mean_of_20_true_ranges_known_by_then(self) -> None:
        # 20 days of 59.99 then 60.00 USD: ATR 59.99 / 60.00
        assert plan1.d1_atr20(h1_days([59.99] * 20), self.END) == pytest.approx(59.99)
        assert plan1.d1_atr20(h1_days([60.0] * 20), self.END) == pytest.approx(60.0)
        # 21 days, the first 200 wide: only the last 20 count (the first one drops out)
        assert plan1.d1_atr20(
            h1_days([200.0] + [60.0] * 20), self.END + pd.Timedelta(days=1)
        ) == pytest.approx(60.0)
        # the forming day (day 21, 1000 wide) is not known before its own midnight + 24 h
        forming = h1_days([60.0] * 20 + [1000.0])
        assert plan1.d1_atr20(
            forming[forming.index <= self.END + pd.Timedelta(hours=5)], self.END + pd.Timedelta(hours=5)
        ) == pytest.approx(60.0)
        # a minute before day 20 is known: only 19 days, too few
        assert np.isnan(plan1.d1_atr20(h1_days([60.0] * 20), self.END - pd.Timedelta(minutes=1)))
        assert np.isnan(plan1.d1_atr20(h1_days([60.0] * 19), self.END)) and np.isnan(
            plan1.d1_atr20(None, self.END)
        )

    def test_a_gap_day_uses_the_previous_close(self) -> None:
        # day 20 opens 50 above day 19's close and trades 4050 +- 5: its true range is 4055 - 4000 = 55, not 10
        d = h1_days([60.0] * 19)
        last = h1_days([10.0], "2026-09-20", close=4050.0)
        assert plan1.d1_atr20(pd.concat([d, last]), self.END) == pytest.approx((19 * 60 + 55) / 20)

    def test_holds_below_60_and_trades_at_60(self, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
        monkeypatch.setattr(plan1, "pools", lambda *a: {})
        df = upto(orb_bars(**BREAK), "2026-09-30 06:17")
        at = pd.Timestamp(df.index[-1])
        day0 = (at.tz_convert("Europe/Athens").normalize() - pd.Timedelta(days=20)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
        for rng, action in ((59.99, Action.HOLD), (60.0, Action.BUY)):
            base = orb_ctx(df)
            ctx = StrategyContext(
                base.market, {**base.frames, Timeframe.H1: h1_days([rng] * 20, day0)}, base.now_utc, base.spec
            )
            sig = Plan1Orb().evaluate(ctx)
            assert sig.action is action
            reg = {c.name: c for c in sig.conditions}["regime"]
            assert reg.passed is (action is Action.BUY) and reg.detail.startswith(f"D1 ATR(20) {rng:.2f}")
        base = orb_ctx(df)
        few = StrategyContext(
            base.market, {**base.frames, Timeframe.H1: h1_days([100.0] * 5, day0)}, base.now_utc, base.spec
        )
        assert Plan1Orb().evaluate(few).action is Action.HOLD  # too few days: no trade
        off = Plan1Orb(Plan1OrbParams(d1_atr20_min_usd=None))
        assert off.evaluate(few).action is Action.BUY


class TestPlan1Orb:
    def test_the_entry_and_its_journal_record(self, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
        monkeypatch.setattr(plan1, "pools", lambda *a: {})
        sig = Plan1Orb().evaluate(orb_ctx(upto(orb_bars(**BREAK), "2026-09-30 06:17")))
        # the ask 4004.8; the stop at the range low 3998: risk 6.8; the target 4004.8 + 1.5 x 6.8 = 4015.0
        assert sig.action is Action.BUY
        assert (sig.entry_price, sig.stop_loss) == (pytest.approx(4004.8), 3998.0)
        assert sig.take_profit == pytest.approx(4015.0)
        names = [c.name for c in sig.conditions]
        assert names == [
            "rule",
            "h1_atr",
            "regime",
            "opening_range",
            "pools",
            "h4_atr_change",
            "pool_break",
            "stop_distance",
            "spread",
        ]
        detail = {c.name: c.detail for c in sig.conditions}
        # the H1 ATR: every H1 bar 3995 .. 4005 before 06:00 = 10; the 06:00 hour is not complete by 06:17
        assert detail["h1_atr"].startswith("H1 ATR 10.00") and "no floor" in detail["h1_atr"]
        assert detail["opening_range"].startswith("3998.00-4004.00 width 6.00 <= 1.5 x H1 ATR 10.00")
        assert "expanding" in detail["h4_atr_change"] and detail["stop_distance"].startswith("6.80")
        assert detail["spread"] == "0.30 (30 points) at the decision quote"  # bid 4004.5, ask 4004.8

    def test_contracting_h4_needs_a_pool_break(self, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
        df = upto(orb_bars(**BREAK), "2026-09-30 06:17")
        monkeypatch.setattr(
            plan1, "pools", lambda *a: {"asia_high": 4010.0}
        )  # above the window's high 4004.8
        held = Plan1Orb().evaluate(orb_ctx(df, expanding=False))
        assert held.action is Action.HOLD and ReasonCode.NO_SETUP.value in held.reason_codes
        failed = [c for c in held.conditions if not c.passed]
        assert [c.name for c in failed] == ["pool_break"] and "none" in failed[0].detail
        # the window (06:02 .. 06:16) opened at 4000 and traded 4004.8: a pool at 4002 is broken
        monkeypatch.setattr(plan1, "pools", lambda *a: {"asia_high": 4002.0})
        sig = Plan1Orb().evaluate(orb_ctx(df, expanding=False))
        assert sig.action is Action.BUY
        assert "asia_high" in {c.name: c.detail for c in sig.conditions}["pool_break"]
        # the rule off: no pool needed
        monkeypatch.setattr(plan1, "pools", lambda *a: {})
        off = Plan1Orb(Plan1OrbParams(pool_break_when_h4_contracting=False))
        assert off.evaluate(orb_ctx(df, expanding=False)).action is Action.BUY
        assert off.required_timeframes() == (Timeframe.M1,)
        assert Plan1Orb().required_timeframes() == (Timeframe.M1,)

    def test_an_unchanged_or_unknown_h4_atr_counts_as_contracting(
        self, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
    ) -> None:
        df = upto(orb_bars(**BREAK), "2026-09-30 06:17")
        monkeypatch.setattr(plan1, "pools", lambda *a: {})
        flat = Plan1Orb().evaluate(orb_ctx(df, expanding=None))  # latest == 24 h earlier: <= is contracting
        assert flat.action is Action.HOLD
        assert "+0.0 % (contracting)" in {c.name: c.detail for c in flat.conditions}["h4_atr_change"]
        unknown = Plan1Orb().evaluate(orb_ctx(df, h4=False))  # no H4 bars: fail closed
        assert unknown.action is Action.HOLD
        assert "unknown" in {c.name: c.detail for c in unknown.conditions}["h4_atr_change"]

    def test_only_at_the_break_bar_and_inside_the_window(self) -> None:
        df = orb_bars(**BREAK)
        assert (
            Plan1Orb().evaluate(orb_ctx(upto(df, "2026-09-30 06:18"))).action is Action.HOLD
        )  # broke already
        early = Plan1Orb().evaluate(orb_ctx(upto(df, "2026-09-30 06:15")))  # the range is still forming
        assert ReasonCode.OUTSIDE_SESSION.value in early.reason_codes
        none = Plan1Orb().evaluate(orb_ctx(upto(df, "2026-09-30 06:16")))  # 06:15 closed inside the range
        assert none.action is Action.HOLD and "no_break" in none.explanation

    def test_no_orb_on_a_saturday(self) -> None:
        sat = orb_bars(**BREAK)
        sat.index = sat.index + pd.Timedelta(days=3)  # Wednesday 2026-09-30 -> Saturday 2026-10-03
        sat["open_time"] = sat["open_time"] + pd.Timedelta(days=3)
        held = Plan1Orb().evaluate(orb_ctx(upto(sat, "2026-10-03 06:17")))
        assert held.action is Action.HOLD and ReasonCode.OUTSIDE_SESSION.value in held.reason_codes

    def test_atr_floor_parameter(self) -> None:
        df = upto(orb_bars(**BREAK), "2026-09-30 06:17")
        held = Plan1Orb(Plan1OrbParams(atr_floor=12.0)).evaluate(orb_ctx(df))  # ATR 10 < 12
        assert held.action is Action.HOLD and [c.name for c in held.conditions if not c.passed] == ["h1_atr"]
        assert Plan1Orb(Plan1OrbParams(atr_floor=10.0)).evaluate(orb_ctx(df)).action is Action.BUY

    def test_time_exit_at_the_bar_close_60_minutes_after_the_entry_minute(self) -> None:
        df = frame("2026-09-29 00:00", "2026-09-30 07:30")
        pos = OpenPosition(
            Side.BUY, 4004.8, 3998.0, 3998.0, 4015.0, datetime(2026, 9, 30, 6, 17, 0, 300_000, tzinfo=UTC)
        )
        s = Plan1Orb()
        assert s.manage_position(orb_ctx(upto(df, "2026-09-30 07:16")), pos) is None
        advice = s.manage_position(orb_ctx(upto(df, "2026-09-30 07:17")), pos)
        assert advice is not None and advice.close is ExitReason.TIME_STOP

    def test_params_are_bounded(self) -> None:
        with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
            Plan1OrbParams(orb_zone="Mars/Base")
        with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
            Plan1OrbParams(orb_open="25:00")
        with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
            Plan1OrbParams(target_r=0)


# --- the NY straddle --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

NY = datetime(2026, 9, 30, 12, 30, tzinfo=UTC)  # 08:30 New York (EDT)


def at(seconds: float) -> datetime:
    return NY + timedelta(seconds=seconds)


class TestDailyStraddle:
    def test_every_weekday_at_0830_new_york(self) -> None:
        p = Plan1StraddleParams()
        assert daily_release(date(2026, 9, 30), p) == Release(NY, "NY0830")
        assert daily_release(date(2026, 11, 4), p).at == datetime(2026, 11, 4, 13, 30, tzinfo=UTC)  # type: ignore[union-attr]  # EST
        assert daily_release(date(2026, 10, 3), p) is None  # Saturday

    def test_triggers_and_stop_in_usd(self) -> None:
        # at a bid of 2000, S2's unit would be 0.5 USD; PLAN-1's straddle is 2 / 8 USD flat
        s = DailyStraddle(Plan1StraddleParams(), ())
        assert s.on_quote(at(-1), 2000.0, 2000.4) is None  # the reference: up 2002.4, down 1998.0
        assert s.on_quote(at(0.5), 2002.0, 2002.39) is None
        e = s.on_quote(at(1.0), 2002.0, 2002.4)
        assert e is not None and e.side is Side.BUY
        assert (e.trigger, e.stop_distance) == (pytest.approx(2002.4), pytest.approx(8.0))
        assert e.close_at == at(1800)
        assert s.on_quote(at(2), 1990.0, 1990.4) is None  # once a day

    def test_the_window_and_the_weekend(self) -> None:
        s = DailyStraddle(Plan1StraddleParams(), ())
        s.on_quote(at(-1), 2000.0, 2000.4)
        assert s.on_quote(at(60), 1990.0, 1990.4) is None  # 08:31:00: the window is over
        sat = datetime(2026, 10, 3, 12, 30, tzinfo=UTC)
        s.on_quote(sat - timedelta(seconds=1), 2000.0, 2000.4)
        assert s.on_quote(sat + timedelta(seconds=1), 1990.0, 1990.4) is None

    def test_busy_spans(self) -> None:
        s = Plan1Straddle()
        assert s.busy_between(NY - timedelta(seconds=40), NY - timedelta(seconds=30))  # arm from 08:29:25
        assert not s.busy_between(NY - timedelta(seconds=60), NY - timedelta(seconds=35))
        assert s.busy_between(at(59), at(60)) and not s.busy_between(at(60), at(120))
        assert not s.busy_between(
            datetime(2026, 10, 3, 12, 0, tzinfo=UTC), datetime(2026, 10, 3, 13, 0, tzinfo=UTC)
        )


def ny_ctx(close_at: datetime, bid: float, ask: float) -> StrategyContext:
    df = frame(
        "2026-09-29 00:00", (pd.Timestamp(close_at) - pd.Timedelta(minutes=1)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
    )
    market = MarketContext(
        symbol="XAUUSD",
        decision_time_utc=close_at,
        entry_timeframe=Timeframe.M1,
        higher_timeframe=Timeframe.H4,
        states=(state(Timeframe.M1, close_at, close=4000.0), state(Timeframe.H4, close_at, close=4000.0)),
        bid=bid,
        ask=ask,
        spread_points=(ask - bid) / XAUUSD_SPEC.point,
        quote_time_utc=at(1),
    )
    return StrategyContext(market, {Timeframe.M1: df, Timeframe.H1: wide_h1(close_at)}, close_at, XAUUSD_SPEC)


class TestPlan1Straddle:
    def test_the_entry_with_its_journal_record(self) -> None:
        s = Plan1Straddle()
        s.attach_calendar((Release(NY, "CPI"), Release(NY + timedelta(days=1), "PPI")))
        assert s.on_quote("XAUUSD", at(-1), 4000.0, 4000.4) is None
        e = s.on_quote("XAUUSD", at(1), 4002.1, 4002.5)
        assert e is not None and e.side is Side.BUY
        sig = s.entry_signal(ny_ctx(NY, 4002.1, 4002.5), e)
        assert sig is not None and sig.action is Action.BUY
        assert (sig.entry_price, sig.stop_loss, sig.take_profit) == (
            4002.5,
            pytest.approx(3994.5),
            pytest.approx(4102.5),
        )
        detail = {c.name: c.detail for c in sig.conditions}
        assert list(detail) == ["rule", "h1_atr", "regime", "release", "pools", "stop_distance", "spread"]
        assert detail["spread"] == "0.40 (40 points) at the decision quote"  # bid 4002.1, ask 4002.5
        assert detail["release"].endswith("CPI") and "4002.40" in detail["rule"]
        # the next weekday trades too, with no release on the calendar there
        nxt = NY + timedelta(days=1)
        s.on_quote("XAUUSD", nxt - timedelta(seconds=1), 4000.0, 4000.4)
        assert s.on_quote("XAUUSD", nxt + timedelta(seconds=1), 3997.9, 3998.3) is not None

    def test_the_regime_switch_refuses_the_straddle(self) -> None:
        s = Plan1Straddle()
        s.on_quote("XAUUSD", at(-1), 4000.0, 4000.4)
        e = s.on_quote("XAUUSD", at(1), 4002.1, 4002.5)
        base = ny_ctx(NY, 4002.1, 4002.5)
        for rng, ok in ((59.99, False), (60.0, True)):
            ctx = StrategyContext(
                base.market,
                {**base.frames, Timeframe.H1: h1_days([rng] * 20, "2026-09-10")},
                base.now_utc,
                base.spec,
            )
            assert e is not None and (s.entry_signal(ctx, e) is not None) is ok

    def test_atr_floor_refuses_the_entry(self) -> None:
        s = Plan1Straddle(Plan1StraddleParams(atr_floor=12.0))  # the flat frame's H1 ATR is 10
        s.on_quote("XAUUSD", at(-1), 4000.0, 4000.4)
        e = s.on_quote("XAUUSD", at(1), 4002.1, 4002.5)
        assert e is not None and s.entry_signal(ny_ctx(NY, 4002.1, 4002.5), e) is None

    def test_out_30_minutes_after_0830(self) -> None:
        # filled at 08:31:00.1 (a trigger in the window's last tenth of a second): still out at 09:00, not 09:01
        s = Plan1Straddle()
        pos = OpenPosition(Side.BUY, 4002.6, 3994.5, 3994.5, 4102.5, at(60.1))
        assert s.manage_position(ny_ctx(at(29 * 60), 4005.0, 4005.4), pos) is None
        advice = s.manage_position(ny_ctx(at(30 * 60), 4005.0, 4005.4), pos)
        assert advice is not None and advice.close is ExitReason.TIME_STOP


def test_both_pieces_are_in_the_catalog() -> None:
    names = set(default_registry().names)
    assert {"setup_plan1_orb", "setup_plan1_ny"} <= names

def utc(text: str) -> pd.Timestamp:
