+"""Crash-recoverable, one-at-a-time mutation check for DEV_SPEC_4.
+
+Run from the repository root with ``.venv/Scripts/python research/.../plant_bugs_4.py``.
+If the process is interrupted, rerunning this script restores any source files it had changed.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+RECOVERY = HERE / ".plant_bugs_4_recovery"
+MANIFEST = RECOVERY / "manifest.json"
+OUTPUT = HERE / "plant_bugs_4_output.txt"
+
+
+def restore() -> None:
+    if MANIFEST.is_file():
+        for item in json.loads(MANIFEST.read_text(encoding="utf-8")):
+            shutil.copyfile(RECOVERY / item["backup"], ROOT / item["path"])
+    shutil.rmtree(RECOVERY, ignore_errors=True)
+
+
+def mutation(path: str, before: str, after: str, test: str, label: str) -> tuple[str, str, str, str, str]:
+    return path, before, after, test, label
+
+
+BUGS = [
+    mutation("app/risk/day_plan.py", '("condition", (r"\\bcondition\\b",)),', '("condition", (r"\\babsent_condition\\b",)),', "tests/unit/test_risk_day_plan.py::test_plan_markers_are_case_insensitive_and_order_independent", "condition marker omitted"),
+    mutation("app/risk/day_plan.py", '("levels", (r"\\blevels\\b",)),', '("levels", (r"\\babsent_levels\\b",)),', "tests/unit/test_risk_day_plan.py::test_plan_markers_are_case_insensitive_and_order_independent", "levels marker omitted"),
+    mutation("app/risk/day_plan.py", '("side with the edge", (r"\\bside with the edge\\b", r"\\bedge_side\\b")),', '("side with the edge", (r"\\babsent_edge\\b",)),', "tests/unit/test_risk_day_plan.py::test_plan_markers_are_case_insensitive_and_order_independent", "edge-side marker omitted"),
+    mutation("app/risk/day_plan.py", '("scenarios", (r"\\bscenarios\\b",)),', '("scenarios", (r"\\babsent_scenarios\\b",)),', "tests/unit/test_risk_day_plan.py::test_plan_markers_are_case_insensitive_and_order_independent", "scenarios marker omitted"),
+    mutation("app/strategy/plan1.py", "class Plan1OrbParams(StrategyParams):\n    require_edge_side: bool = False", "class Plan1OrbParams(StrategyParams):\n    require_edge_side: bool = True", "tests/unit/test_plan1.py::TestPlan1Orb::test_edge_defaults_stay_off_and_warmup_grows_only_when_enabled", "ORB default switched on"),
+    mutation("app/strategy/plan1.py", "lean = behind(edge_lean(ctx.frames, at, market.entry_timeframe), own_side)\n            except ValueError:\n                lean = None\n            edge_ok = lean is not None and lean >= 0", "lean = behind(edge_lean(ctx.frames, at, market.entry_timeframe), own_side)\n            except ValueError:\n                lean = None\n            edge_ok = True", "tests/unit/test_plan1.py::TestPlan1Orb::test_the_optional_edge_gate_refuses_an_opposing_or_unreadable_h4", "ORB edge refusal bypassed"),
+    mutation("app/strategy/plan1.py", 'edge_ok = not any(c.name == "edge_side" and not c.passed for c in conds)', "edge_ok = True", "tests/unit/test_plan1.py::TestPlan1Straddle::test_the_optional_edge_gate_refuses_a_buy_against_h4_and_reads_context_timeframe", "NY edge refusal bypassed"),
+    mutation("app/strategy/plan1_b2.py", "edge_ok = lean is not None and lean >= 0", "edge_ok = True", "tests/unit/test_plan1_b2.py::test_optional_edge_gate_uses_the_context_entry_frame_and_fails_closed", "B2 / B2M5 edge refusal bypassed"),
+]
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    restore()
+    originals: dict[str, bytes] = {}
+    for path, *_ in BUGS:
+        target = ROOT / path
+        originals[path] = target.read_bytes()
+    RECOVERY.mkdir(parents=True)
+    items = []
+    for index, (path, *_rest) in enumerate(BUGS):
+        backup = f"source_{index}.bin"
+        (RECOVERY / backup).write_bytes(originals[path])
+        items.append({"path": path, "backup": backup})
+    MANIFEST.write_text(json.dumps(items), encoding="utf-8")
+
+    lines = ["DEV_SPEC_4 planted-bug report", "Each mutant was restored before the next was planted.", ""]
+    try:
+        for path, before, after, test, label in BUGS:
+            target = ROOT / path
+            current = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+            if current.count(before) != 1:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"expected exactly one mutation site for {label} in {path}")
+            target.write_text(current.replace(before, after, 1), encoding="utf-8")
+            result = subprocess.run(
+                [sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", "-q", test],
+                cwd=ROOT,
+                capture_output=True,
+                text=True,
+                check=False,
+            )
+            restore()
+            # Recreate the recovery journal for the next mutant, with clean source bytes.
+            RECOVERY.mkdir(parents=True)
+            items = []
+            for index, (source, *_rest) in enumerate(BUGS):
+                backup = f"source_{index}.bin"
+                (RECOVERY / backup).write_bytes(originals[source])
+                items.append({"path": source, "backup": backup})
+            MANIFEST.write_text(json.dumps(items), encoding="utf-8")
+            status = "CAUGHT" if result.returncode else "MISSED"
+            summary = next((line.strip() for line in result.stdout.splitlines() if "failed" in line or "passed" in line), "no pytest summary")
+            lines.append(f"{status}: {label} | {test} | {summary}")
+            OUTPUT.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+        restore()
+    finally:
+        restore()
+    missed = sum(line.startswith("MISSED:") for line in lines)
+    lines.extend(["", f"Caught: {len(BUGS) - missed}; missed: {missed}."])
+    OUTPUT.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    return int(missed > 0)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+"""Crash-recoverable, one-at-a-time mutation check for DEV_SPEC_4.
+
+Run from the repository root with ``.venv/Scripts/python research/.../plant_bugs_4.py``.
+If the process is interrupted, rerunning this script restores any source files it had changed.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+RECOVERY = HERE / ".plant_bugs_4_recovery"
+MANIFEST = RECOVERY / "manifest.json"
+OUTPUT = HERE / "plant_bugs_4_output.txt"
+
+
+def restore() -> None:
+    if MANIFEST.is_file():
+        for item in json.loads(MANIFEST.read_text(encoding="utf-8")):
+            shutil.copyfile(RECOVERY / item["backup"], ROOT / item["path"])
+    shutil.rmtree(RECOVERY, ignore_errors=True)
+
+
+def mutation(path: str, before: str, after: str, test: str, label: str) -> tuple[str, str, str, str, str]:
+    return path, before, after, test, label
+
+
+BUGS = [
+    mutation("app/risk/day_plan.py", '("condition", (r"\\bcondition\\b",)),', '("condition", (r"\\babsent_condition\\b",)),', "tests/unit/test_risk_day_plan.py::test_plan_markers_are_case_insensitive_and_order_independent", "condition marker omitted"),
+    mutation("app/risk/day_plan.py", '("levels", (r"\\blevels\\b",)),', '("levels", (r"\\babsent_levels\\b",)),', "tests/unit/test_risk_day_plan.py::test_plan_markers_are_case_insensitive_and_order_independent", "levels marker omitted"),
+    mutation("app/risk/day_plan.py", '("side with the edge", (r"\\bside with the edge\\b", r"\\bedge_side\\b")),', '("side with the edge", (r"\\babsent_edge\\b",)),', "tests/unit/test_risk_day_plan.py::test_plan_markers_are_case_insensitive_and_order_independent", "edge-side marker omitted"),
+    mutation("app/risk/day_plan.py", '("scenarios", (r"\\bscenarios\\b",)),', '("scenarios", (r"\\babsent_scenarios\\b",)),', "tests/unit/test_risk_day_plan.py::test_plan_markers_are_case_insensitive_and_order_independent", "scenarios marker omitted"),
+    mutation("app/strategy/plan1.py", "class Plan1OrbParams(StrategyParams):\n    require_edge_side: bool = False", "class Plan1OrbParams(StrategyParams):\n    require_edge_side: bool = True", "tests/unit/test_plan1.py::TestPlan1Orb::test_edge_defaults_stay_off_and_warmup_grows_only_when_enabled", "ORB default switched on"),
+    mutation("app/strategy/plan1.py", "lean = behind(edge_lean(ctx.frames, at, market.entry_timeframe), own_side)\n            except ValueError:\n                lean = None\n            edge_ok = lean is not None and lean >= 0", "lean = behind(edge_lean(ctx.frames, at, market.entry_timeframe), own_side)\n            except ValueError:\n                lean = None\n            edge_ok = True", "tests/unit/test_plan1.py::TestPlan1Orb::test_the_optional_edge_gate_refuses_an_opposing_or_unreadable_h4", "ORB edge refusal bypassed"),
+    mutation("app/strategy/plan1.py", "lean = behind(edge_lean(ctx.frames, at, ctx.market.entry_timeframe), own_side)\n            except ValueError:\n                lean = None\n            edge_ok = lean is not None and lean >= 0", "lean = behind(edge_lean(ctx.frames, at, ctx.market.entry_timeframe), own_side)\n            except ValueError:\n                lean = None\n            edge_ok = True", "tests/unit/test_plan1.py::TestPlan1Straddle::test_the_optional_edge_gate_refuses_a_buy_against_h4_and_reads_context_timeframe", "NY edge refusal bypassed"),
+    mutation("app/strategy/plan1_b2.py", "edge_ok = lean is not None and lean >= 0", "edge_ok = True", "tests/unit/test_plan1_b2.py::test_optional_edge_gate_uses_the_context_entry_frame_and_fails_closed", "B2 / B2M5 edge refusal bypassed"),
+]
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    restore()
+    originals: dict[str, bytes] = {}
+    for path, *_ in BUGS:
+        target = ROOT / path
+        originals[path] = target.read_bytes()
+    RECOVERY.mkdir(parents=True)
+    items = []
+    for index, (path, *_rest) in enumerate(BUGS):
+        backup = f"source_{index}.bin"
+        (RECOVERY / backup).write_bytes(originals[path])
+        items.append({"path": path, "backup": backup})
+    MANIFEST.write_text(json.dumps(items), encoding="utf-8")
+
+    lines = ["DEV_SPEC_4 planted-bug report", "Each mutant was restored before the next was planted.", ""]
+    try:
+        for path, before, after, test, label in BUGS:
+            target = ROOT / path
+            current = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+            if current.count(before) != 1:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"expected exactly one mutation site for {label} in {path}")
+            target.write_text(current.replace(before, after, 1), encoding="utf-8")
+            result = subprocess.run(
+                [sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", "-q", test],
+                cwd=ROOT,
+                capture_output=True,
+                text=True,
+                check=False,
+            )
+            restore()
+            # Recreate the recovery journal for the next mutant, with clean source bytes.
+            RECOVERY.mkdir(parents=True)
+            items = []
+            for index, (source, *_rest) in enumerate(BUGS):
+                backup = f"source_{index}.bin"
+                (RECOVERY / backup).write_bytes(originals[source])
+                items.append({"path": source, "backup": backup})
+            MANIFEST.write_text(json.dumps(items), encoding="utf-8")
+            status = "CAUGHT" if result.returncode else "MISSED"
+            summary = next((line.strip() for line in result.stdout.splitlines() if "failed" in line or "passed" in line), "no pytest summary")
+            lines.append(f"{status}: {label} | {test} | {summary}")
+            OUTPUT.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+        restore()
+    finally:
+        restore()
+    missed = sum(line.startswith("MISSED:") for line in lines)
+    lines.extend(["", f"Caught: {len(BUGS) - missed}; missed: {missed}."])
+    OUTPUT.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    return int(missed > 0)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":

+# DEV_SPEC_4 implementation notes
+
+## Gap 1: H4 edge rule on PLAN-1
+
+Added `require_edge_side: bool = False` to the ORB, NY straddle and B2 parameter models. Each enabled gate uses the existing `edge_lean()` and `behind()` functions, with the context's `entry_timeframe`. A missing reading or a `ValueError` is recorded as unreadable and refuses the entry. The rule is `behind(...) >= 0`, so a zero lean is allowed and a negative lean is refused. The condition is omitted when the option is off to preserve default signal output.
+
+ORB and B2/B2M5 use M1 and M5 entries; the NY straddle enters from quotes and reads its context entry timeframe. None enters at H4 or above, so the gate was not forced onto an entry frame where no larger H4 frame exists. When enabled, each warmup requests at least 64 H4 bars (256 H1 bars, or 15,360 M1 bars).
+
+## Gap 2: complete day plan
+
+`DayPlan.check()` reads at most `READ_LIMIT` bytes, checks case-insensitive whole-word markers for condition, levels, the side with the edge, and scenarios, and returns a detail naming missing sections. `exists()` keeps its boolean API. The orchestrator passes the detailed check result into the DAY_PLAN gate. The AI markdown writer now emits an explicit `- scenarios:` marker, matching its `DayPlan.scenarios` field. Existing file, directory, empty, whitespace, unreadable, invalid UTF-8 and bounded-read refusals remain fail-closed.
+
+The shared integration test plan and late-plan fixture now contain all four required sections. The API sample fixture includes the four new optional parameters with `false` defaults.
+
+## Tests and mutations
+
+Each mutant was planted against the production implementation, exercised by the named test, and restored by `plant_bugs_4.py`'s recovery journal and `finally` handler. The output is in `plant_bugs_4_output.txt`.
+
+| Test | Planted change | Result |
+|---|---|---|
+| `test_plan_markers_are_case_insensitive_and_order_independent` | Remove condition marker | CAUGHT |
+| `test_plan_markers_are_case_insensitive_and_order_independent` | Remove levels marker | CAUGHT |
+| `test_plan_markers_are_case_insensitive_and_order_independent` | Remove edge-side marker | CAUGHT |
+| `test_plan_markers_are_case_insensitive_and_order_independent` | Remove scenarios marker | CAUGHT |
+| `TestPlan1Orb.test_edge_defaults_stay_off_and_warmup_grows_only_when_enabled` | Change ORB default to on | CAUGHT |
+| `TestPlan1Orb.test_the_optional_edge_gate_refuses_an_opposing_or_unreadable_h4` | Bypass ORB's negative-lean refusal | CAUGHT |
+| `TestPlan1Straddle.test_the_optional_edge_gate_refuses_a_buy_against_h4_and_reads_context_timeframe` | Bypass NY's negative-lean refusal | CAUGHT |
+| `test_optional_edge_gate_uses_the_context_entry_frame_and_fails_closed` | Bypass B2/B2M5's negative-lean refusal | CAUGHT |
+
+Mutation result: **8 caught, 0 missed**. The first mutation-runner attempt reported one missed NY mutation because it changed a redundant downstream check. That check was removed; the mutation was retargeted to the journal gate, and the final run caught all eight.
+
+## Defaults and parity
+
+All four new options default to `False`. Default strategy decisions do not add an edge condition, and warmups stay at their previous values when the option is off. Existing golden/parity tests passed in the first complete pytest run; no parity or golden-number files were edited. The API sample change only exposes the newly added optional fields as `false`.
+
+## Validation
+
+- Focused unit run: **92 passed** before the final NY check simplification; the final mutation runner then exercised the NY production gate and caught its bypass.
+- Affected integration files after fixing their plan fixtures: **29 passed**.
+- Combined focused rerun after the day-plan marker, `ValueError` handling and fixture fixes: **102 passed**.
+- API sample test after fixture regeneration: **1 passed**.
+- Scanner integration file: **12 passed**.
+- Ruff format check: **520 files already formatted**.
+- Ruff check: **passed**.
+- Mypy: **349 source files, no issues**.
+- Bandit: **no issues identified**.
+- Full pytest first completed with **3,998 passed, 9 skipped, 19 failed**. Eighteen failures used intentionally incomplete generic plan fixtures; the other was the API sample now updated. The 29 affected integration tests and API sample test passed after those fixes.
+- Two subsequent full-suite retries terminated with Windows native access violations during scanner/demo integration activity (one in the scanner test, one in the day-plan gate loop while pandas aggregated `fake_mt5` bars). Those tests pass in isolated runs. Therefore, the final full suite is **not recorded as green**.

No push was made. `.env`, `config.yaml`, `docs/`, and `research/2026-10-26-three-bots/weights*` were not edited. No PLAN-1 entry timeframe is H4 or higher.

+"""Crash-recoverable, one-at-a-time mutation check for DEV_SPEC_4.
+
+Run from the repository root with ``.venv/Scripts/python research/.../plant_bugs_4.py``.
+If the process is interrupted, rerunning this script restores any source files it had changed.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+RECOVERY = HERE / ".plant_bugs_4_recovery"
+MANIFEST = RECOVERY / "manifest.json"
+OUTPUT = HERE / "plant_bugs_4_output.txt"
+
+
+def restore() -> None:
+    if MANIFEST.is_file():
+        for item in json.loads(MANIFEST.read_text(encoding="utf-8")):
+            shutil.copyfile(RECOVERY / item["backup"], ROOT / item["path"])
+    shutil.rmtree(RECOVERY, ignore_errors=True)
+
+
+def mutation(path: str, before: str, after: str, test: str, label: str) -> tuple[str, str, str, str, str]:
+    return path, before, after, test, label
+
+
+BUGS = [
+    mutation("app/risk/day_plan.py", '("condition", (r"\\bcondition\\b",)),', '("condition", (r"\\babsent_condition\\b",)),', "tests/unit/test_risk_day_plan.py::test_plan_markers_are_case_insensitive_and_order_independent", "condition marker omitted"),
+    mutation("app/risk/day_plan.py", '("levels", (r"\\blevels\\b",)),', '("levels", (r"\\babsent_levels\\b",)),', "tests/unit/test_risk_day_plan.py::test_plan_markers_are_case_insensitive_and_order_independent", "levels marker omitted"),
+    mutation("app/risk/day_plan.py", '("side with the edge", (r"\\bside with the edge\\b", r"\\bedge_side\\b")),', '("side with the edge", (r"\\babsent_edge\\b",)),', "tests/unit/test_risk_day_plan.py::test_plan_markers_are_case_insensitive_and_order_independent", "edge-side marker omitted"),
+    mutation("app/risk/day_plan.py", '("scenarios", (r"\\bscenarios\\b",)),', '("scenarios", (r"\\babsent_scenarios\\b",)),', "tests/unit/test_risk_day_plan.py::test_plan_markers_are_case_insensitive_and_order_independent", "scenarios marker omitted"),
+    mutation("app/strategy/plan1.py", "class Plan1OrbParams(StrategyParams):\n    require_edge_side: bool = False", "class Plan1OrbParams(StrategyParams):\n    require_edge_side: bool = True", "tests/unit/test_plan1.py::TestPlan1Orb::test_edge_defaults_stay_off_and_warmup_grows_only_when_enabled", "ORB default switched on"),
+    mutation("app/strategy/plan1.py", "lean = behind(edge_lean(ctx.frames, at, market.entry_timeframe), own_side)\n            except ValueError:\n                lean = None\n            edge_ok = lean is not None and lean >= 0", "lean = behind(edge_lean(ctx.frames, at, market.entry_timeframe), own_side)\n            except ValueError:\n                lean = None\n            edge_ok = True", "tests/unit/test_plan1.py::TestPlan1Orb::test_the_optional_edge_gate_refuses_an_opposing_or_unreadable_h4", "ORB edge refusal bypassed"),
+    mutation("app/strategy/plan1.py", "lean = behind(edge_lean(ctx.frames, at, ctx.market.entry_timeframe), own_side)\n            except ValueError:\n                lean = None\n            edge_ok = lean is not None and lean >= 0", "lean = behind(edge_lean(ctx.frames, at, ctx.market.entry_timeframe), own_side)\n            except ValueError:\n                lean = None\n            edge_ok = True", "tests/unit/test_plan1.py::TestPlan1Straddle::test_the_optional_edge_gate_refuses_a_buy_against_h4_and_reads_context_timeframe", "NY edge refusal bypassed"),
+    mutation("app/strategy/plan1_b2.py", "edge_ok = lean is not None and lean >= 0", "edge_ok = True", "tests/unit/test_plan1_b2.py::test_optional_edge_gate_uses_the_context_entry_frame_and_fails_closed", "B2 / B2M5 edge refusal bypassed"),
+]
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    restore()
+    originals: dict[str, bytes] = {}
+    for path, *_ in BUGS:
+        target = ROOT / path
+        originals[path] = target.read_bytes()
+    RECOVERY.mkdir(parents=True)
+    items = []
+    for index, (path, *_rest) in enumerate(BUGS):
+        backup = f"source_{index}.bin"
+        (RECOVERY / backup).write_bytes(originals[path])
+        items.append({"path": path, "backup": backup})
+    MANIFEST.write_text(json.dumps(items), encoding="utf-8")
+
+    lines = ["DEV_SPEC_4 planted-bug report", "Each mutant was restored before the next was planted.", ""]
+    try:
+        for path, before, after, test, label in BUGS:
+            target = ROOT / path
+            current = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+            if current.count(before) != 1:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"expected exactly one mutation site for {label} in {path}")
+            target.write_text(current.replace(before, after, 1), encoding="utf-8")
+            result = subprocess.run(
+                [sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", "-q", test],
+                cwd=ROOT,
+                capture_output=True,
+                text=True,
+                check=False,
+            )
+            restore()
+            # Recreate the recovery journal for the next mutant, with clean source bytes.
+            RECOVERY.mkdir(parents=True)
+            items = []
+            for index, (source, *_rest) in enumerate(BUGS):
+                backup = f"source_{index}.bin"
+                (RECOVERY / backup).write_bytes(originals[source])
+                items.append({"path": source, "backup": backup})
+            MANIFEST.write_text(json.dumps(items), encoding="utf-8")
+            status = "CAUGHT" if result.returncode else "MISSED"
+            summary = next((line.strip() for line in result.stdout.splitlines() if "failed" in line or "passed" in line), "no pytest summary")
+            lines.append(f"{status}: {label} | {test} | {summary}")
+            OUTPUT.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+        restore()
+    finally:
+        restore()
+    missed = sum(line.startswith("MISSED:") for line in lines)
+    lines.extend(["", f"Caught: {len(BUGS) - missed}; missed: {missed}."])
+    OUTPUT.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    return int(missed > 0)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+# DEV_SPEC_4 implementation notes
+
+## Gap 1: H4 edge rule on PLAN-1
+
+Added `require_edge_side: bool = False` to the ORB, NY straddle and B2 parameter models. Each enabled gate uses the existing `edge_lean()` and `behind()` functions, with the context's `entry_timeframe`. A missing reading or a `ValueError` is recorded as unreadable and refuses the entry. The rule is `behind(...) >= 0`, so a zero lean is allowed and a negative lean is refused. The condition is omitted when the option is off to preserve default signal output.
+
+ORB and B2/B2M5 use M1 and M5 entries; the NY straddle enters from quotes and reads its context entry timeframe. None enters at H4 or above, so the gate was not forced onto an entry frame where no larger H4 frame exists. When enabled, each warmup requests at least 64 H4 bars (256 H1 bars, or 15,360 M1 bars).
+
+## Gap 2: complete day plan
+
+`DayPlan.check()` reads at most `READ_LIMIT` bytes, checks case-insensitive whole-word markers for condition, levels, the side with the edge, and scenarios, and returns a detail naming missing sections. `exists()` keeps its boolean API. The orchestrator passes the detailed check result into the DAY_PLAN gate. The AI markdown writer now emits an explicit `- scenarios:` marker, matching its `DayPlan.scenarios` field. Existing file, directory, empty, whitespace, unreadable, invalid UTF-8 and bounded-read refusals remain fail-closed.
+
+The shared integration test plan and late-plan fixture now contain all four required sections. The API sample fixture includes the four new optional parameters with `false` defaults.
+
+## Tests and mutations
+
+Each mutant was planted against the production implementation, exercised by the named test, and restored by `plant_bugs_4.py`'s recovery journal and `finally` handler. The output is in `plant_bugs_4_output.txt`.
+
+| Test | Planted change | Result |
+|---|---|---|
+| `test_plan_markers_are_case_insensitive_and_order_independent` | Remove condition marker | CAUGHT |
+| `test_plan_markers_are_case_insensitive_and_order_independent` | Remove levels marker | CAUGHT |
+| `test_plan_markers_are_case_insensitive_and_order_independent` | Remove edge-side marker | CAUGHT |
+| `test_plan_markers_are_case_insensitive_and_order_independent` | Remove scenarios marker | CAUGHT |
+| `TestPlan1Orb.test_edge_defaults_stay_off_and_warmup_grows_only_when_enabled` | Change ORB default to on | CAUGHT |
+| `TestPlan1Orb.test_the_optional_edge_gate_refuses_an_opposing_or_unreadable_h4` | Bypass ORB's negative-lean refusal | CAUGHT |
+| `TestPlan1Straddle.test_the_optional_edge_gate_refuses_a_buy_against_h4_and_reads_context_timeframe` | Bypass NY's negative-lean refusal | CAUGHT |
+| `test_optional_edge_gate_uses_the_context_entry_frame_and_fails_closed` | Bypass B2/B2M5's negative-lean refusal | CAUGHT |
+
+Mutation result: **8 caught, 0 missed**. The first mutation-runner attempt reported one missed NY mutation because it changed a redundant downstream check. That check was removed; the mutation was retargeted to the journal gate, and the final run caught all eight.
+
+## Defaults and parity
+
+All four new options default to `False`. Default strategy decisions do not add an edge condition, and warmups stay at their previous values when the option is off. Existing golden/parity tests passed in the first complete pytest run; no parity or golden-number files were edited. The API sample change only exposes the newly added optional fields as `false`.
+
+## Validation
+
+- Focused unit run: **92 passed** before the final NY check simplification; the final mutation runner then exercised the NY production gate and caught its bypass.
+- Affected integration files after fixing their plan fixtures: **29 passed**.
+- Combined focused rerun after the day-plan marker, `ValueError` handling and fixture fixes: **102 passed**.
+- API sample test after fixture regeneration: **1 passed**.
+- Scanner integration file: **12 passed**.
+- Ruff format check: **520 files already formatted**.
+- Ruff check: **passed**.
+- Mypy: **349 source files, no issues**.
+- Bandit: **no issues identified**.
+- Full pytest first completed with **3,998 passed, 9 skipped, 19 failed**. Eighteen failures used intentionally incomplete generic plan fixtures; the other was the API sample now updated. The 29 affected integration tests and API sample test passed after those fixes.
+- Two subsequent full-suite retries terminated with Windows native access violations during scanner/demo integration activity (one in the scanner test, one in the day-plan gate loop while pandas aggregated `fake_mt5` bars). Those tests pass in isolated runs. Therefore, the final full suite is **not recorded as green**.

+"""Crash-recoverable, one-at-a-time mutation check for DEV_SPEC_4.
+
+Run from the repository root with ``.venv/Scripts/python research/.../plant_bugs_4.py``.
+If the process is interrupted, rerunning this script restores any source files it had changed.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+RECOVERY = HERE / ".plant_bugs_4_recovery"
+MANIFEST = RECOVERY / "manifest.json"
+OUTPUT = HERE / "plant_bugs_4_output.txt"
+
+
+def restore() -> None:
+    if MANIFEST.is_file():
+        for item in json.loads(MANIFEST.read_text(encoding="utf-8")):

+def main() -> int:
+    restore()
+    originals: dict[str, bytes] = {}
+    for path, *_ in BUGS:
+        target = ROOT / path
+        originals[path] = target.read_bytes()
+    RECOVERY.mkdir(parents=True)
+    items = []
+    for index, (path, *_rest) in enumerate(BUGS):
+        backup = f"source_{index}.bin"
+        (RECOVERY / backup).write_bytes(originals[path])
+        items.append({"path": path, "backup": backup})
+    MANIFEST.write_text(json.dumps(items), encoding="utf-8")
+
+    lines = ["DEV_SPEC_4 planted-bug report", "Each mutant was restored before the next was planted.", ""]
+    try:
+        for path, before, after, test, label in BUGS:
+            target = ROOT / path
+            current = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+            if current.count(before) != 1:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"expected exactly one mutation site for {label} in {path}")
+            target.write_text(current.replace(before, after, 1), encoding="utf-8")
+            result = subprocess.run(
+                [sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", "-q", test],
+                cwd=ROOT,
+                capture_output=True,
+                text=True,
+                check=False,
+            )
+            restore()
+            # Recreate the recovery journal for the next mutant, with clean source bytes.
+            RECOVERY.mkdir(parents=True)
+            items = []
+            for index, (source, *_rest) in enumerate(BUGS):
+                backup = f"source_{index}.bin"
+                (RECOVERY / backup).write_bytes(originals[source])
+                items.append({"path": source, "backup": backup})
+            MANIFEST.write_text(json.dumps(items), encoding="utf-8")
+            status = "CAUGHT" if result.returncode else "MISSED"
+            summary = next((line.strip() for line in result.stdout.splitlines() if "failed" in line or "passed" in line), "no pytest summary")
+            lines.append(f"{status}: {label} | {test} | {summary}")
+            OUTPUT.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+        restore()
+    finally:
+        restore()
+    missed = sum(line.startswith("MISSED:") for line in lines)
+    lines.extend(["", f"Caught: {len(BUGS) - missed}; missed: {missed}."])
+    OUTPUT.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    return int(missed > 0)
+
+

+    raise SystemExit(main())

+# DEV_SPEC_4 implementation notes
+
+## Gap 1: H4 edge rule on PLAN-1
+
+Added `require_edge_side: bool = False` to the ORB, NY straddle and B2 parameter models. Each enabled gate uses the existing `edge_lean()` and `behind()` functions, with the context's `entry_timeframe`. A missing reading or a `ValueError` is recorded as unreadable and refuses the entry. The rule is `behind(...) >= 0`, so a zero lean is allowed and a negative lean is refused. The condition is omitted when the option is off to preserve default signal output.
+
+ORB and B2/B2M5 use M1 and M5 entries; the NY straddle enters from quotes and reads its context entry timeframe. None enters at H4 or above, so the gate was not forced onto an entry frame where no larger H4 frame exists. When enabled, each warmup requests at least 64 H4 bars (256 H1 bars, or 15,360 M1 bars).
+
+## Gap 2: complete day plan
+
+`DayPlan.check()` reads at most `READ_LIMIT` bytes, checks case-insensitive whole-word markers for condition, levels, the side with the edge, and scenarios, and returns a detail naming missing sections. `exists()` keeps its boolean API. The orchestrator passes the detailed check result into the DAY_PLAN gate. The AI markdown writer now emits an explicit `- scenarios:` marker, matching its `DayPlan.scenarios` field. Existing file, directory, empty, whitespace, unreadable, invalid UTF-8 and bounded-read refusals remain fail-closed.
+
+The shared integration test plan and late-plan fixture now contain all four required sections. The API sample fixture includes the four new optional parameters with `false` defaults.
+
+## Tests and mutations
+
+Each mutant was planted against the production implementation, exercised by the named test, and restored by `plant_bugs_4.py`'s recovery journal and `finally` handler. The output is in `plant_bugs_4_output.txt`.
+
+| Test | Planted change | Result |
+|---|---|---|
+| `test_plan_markers_are_case_insensitive_and_order_independent` | Remove condition marker | CAUGHT |
+| `test_plan_markers_are_case_insensitive_and_order_independent` | Remove levels marker | CAUGHT |
+| `test_plan_markers_are_case_insensitive_and_order_independent` | Remove edge-side marker | CAUGHT |
+| `test_plan_markers_are_case_insensitive_and_order_independent` | Remove scenarios marker | CAUGHT |
+| `TestPlan1Orb.test_edge_defaults_stay_off_and_warmup_grows_only_when_enabled` | Change ORB default to on | CAUGHT |
+| `TestPlan1Orb.test_the_optional_edge_gate_refuses_an_opposing_or_unreadable_h4` | Bypass ORB's negative-lean refusal | CAUGHT |
+| `TestPlan1Straddle.test_the_optional_edge_gate_refuses_a_buy_against_h4_and_reads_context_timeframe` | Bypass NY's negative-lean refusal | CAUGHT |
+| `test_optional_edge_gate_uses_the_context_entry_frame_and_fails_closed` | Bypass B2/B2M5's negative-lean refusal | CAUGHT |
+
+Mutation result: **8 caught, 0 missed**. The first mutation-runner attempt reported one missed NY mutation because it changed a redundant downstream check. That check was removed; the mutation was retargeted to the journal gate, and the final run caught all eight.
+
+## Defaults and parity
+
+All four new options default to `False`. Default strategy decisions do not add an edge condition, and warmups stay at their previous values when the option is off. Existing golden/parity tests passed in the first complete pytest run; no parity or golden-number files were edited. The API sample change only exposes the newly added optional fields as `false`.
+
+## Validation
+
+- Focused unit run: **92 passed** before the final NY check simplification; the final mutation runner then exercised the NY production gate and caught its bypass.
+- Affected integration files after fixing their plan fixtures: **29 passed**.
+- Combined focused rerun after the day-plan marker, `ValueError` handling and fixture fixes: **102 passed**.
+- API sample test after fixture regeneration: **1 passed**.
+- Scanner integration file: **12 passed**.
+- Ruff format check: **520 files already formatted**.
+- Ruff check: **passed**.
+- Mypy: **349 source files, no issues**.
+- Bandit: **no issues identified**.
+- Full pytest first completed with **3,998 passed, 9 skipped, 19 failed**. Eighteen failures used intentionally incomplete generic plan fixtures; the other was the API sample now updated. The 29 affected integration tests and API sample test passed after those fixes.
+- Two subsequent full-suite retries terminated with Windows native access violations during scanner/demo integration activity (one in the scanner test, one in the day-plan gate loop while pandas aggregated `fake_mt5` bars). Those tests pass in isolated runs. Therefore, the final full suite is **not recorded as green**.
+
+## Conflict and scope
+
+DEV_SPEC_4 asks for `plant_bugs_4_output.txt` to be committed, while the owner's instruction for this task says never commit. The output file was written, but no commit was made. No push was made. `.env`, `config.yaml`, `docs/`, and `research/2026-10-26-three-bots/weights*` were not edited. No PLAN-1 entry timeframe is H4 or higher.

+"""Crash-recoverable, one-at-a-time mutation check for DEV_SPEC_4.
+
+Run from the repository root with ``.venv/Scripts/python research/.../plant_bugs_4.py``.
+If the process is interrupted, rerunning this script restores any source files it had changed.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+RECOVERY = HERE / ".plant_bugs_4_recovery"
+MANIFEST = RECOVERY / "manifest.json"
+OUTPUT = HERE / "plant_bugs_4_output.txt"
+
+
+def restore() -> None:
+    if MANIFEST.is_file():
+        for item in json.loads(MANIFEST.read_text(encoding="utf-8")):
+            shutil.copyfile(RECOVERY / item["backup"], ROOT / item["path"])
+    shutil.rmtree(RECOVERY, ignore_errors=True)
+
+
+def mutation(path: str, before: str, after: str, test: str, label: str) -> tuple[str, str, str, str, str]:
+    return path, before, after, test, label
+
+
+BUGS = [
+    mutation(
+        "app/risk/day_plan.py",
+        '("condition", (r"\\bcondition\\b",)),',
+        '("condition", (r"\\babsent_condition\\b",)),',
+        "tests/unit/test_risk_day_plan.py::test_plan_markers_are_case_insensitive_and_order_independent",
+        "condition marker omitted",
+    ),
+    mutation(
+        "app/risk/day_plan.py",
+        '("levels", (r"\\blevels\\b",)),',
+        '("levels", (r"\\babsent_levels\\b",)),',
+        "tests/unit/test_risk_day_plan.py::test_plan_markers_are_case_insensitive_and_order_independent",
+        "levels marker omitted",
+    ),
+    mutation(
+        "app/risk/day_plan.py",
+        '("side with the edge", (r"\\bside with the edge\\b", r"\\bedge_side\\b")),',
+        '("side with the edge", (r"\\babsent_edge\\b",)),',
+        "tests/unit/test_risk_day_plan.py::test_plan_markers_are_case_insensitive_and_order_independent",
+        "edge-side marker omitted",
+    ),
+    mutation(
+        "app/risk/day_plan.py",
+        '("scenarios", (r"\\bscenarios\\b",)),',
+        '("scenarios", (r"\\babsent_scenarios\\b",)),',
+        "tests/unit/test_risk_day_plan.py::test_plan_markers_are_case_insensitive_and_order_independent",

+        "app/ai/plan.py",
+        '"- scenarios:",',
+        '"- scenario list:",',

+        "AI scenario marker omitted",
+    ),
+]
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    restore()
+    originals: dict[str, bytes] = {}
+    for path, *_ in BUGS:
+        target = ROOT / path
+        originals[path] = target.read_bytes()
+    RECOVERY.mkdir(parents=True)
+    items = []
+    for index, (path, *_rest) in enumerate(BUGS):
+        backup = f"source_{index}.bin"
+        (RECOVERY / backup).write_bytes(originals[path])
+        items.append({"path": path, "backup": backup})
+    MANIFEST.write_text(json.dumps(items), encoding="utf-8")
+
+    lines = ["DEV_SPEC_4 planted-bug report", "Each mutant was restored before the next was planted.", ""]
+    try:
+        for path, before, after, test, label in BUGS:
+            target = ROOT / path
+            current = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+            if current.count(before) != 1:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"expected exactly one mutation site for {label} in {path}")
+            target.write_text(current.replace(before, after, 1), encoding="utf-8")
+            result = subprocess.run(
+                [sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", "-q", test],
+                cwd=ROOT,
+                capture_output=True,
+                text=True,
+                check=False,
+            )
+            restore()
+            # Recreate the recovery journal for the next mutant, with clean source bytes.
+            RECOVERY.mkdir(parents=True)
+            items = []
+            for index, (source, *_rest) in enumerate(BUGS):
+                backup = f"source_{index}.bin"
+                (RECOVERY / backup).write_bytes(originals[source])
+                items.append({"path": source, "backup": backup})
+            MANIFEST.write_text(json.dumps(items), encoding="utf-8")
+            status = "CAUGHT" if result.returncode else "MISSED"
+            summary = next(
+                (line.strip() for line in result.stdout.splitlines() if "failed" in line or "passed" in line),
+                "no pytest summary",
+            )
+            lines.append(f"{status}: {label} | {test} | {summary}")
+            OUTPUT.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+        restore()
+    finally:
+        restore()
+    missed = sum(line.startswith("MISSED:") for line in lines)
+    lines.extend(["", f"Caught: {len(BUGS) - missed}; missed: {missed}."])
+    OUTPUT.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    return int(missed > 0)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

# DEV_SPEC_4 implementation notes

## Gap 1: H4 edge rule on PLAN-1

Added `require_edge_side: bool = False` to the ORB, NY straddle and B2 parameter models. Each enabled gate uses the existing `edge_lean()` and `behind()` functions, with the context's `entry_timeframe`. A missing reading or a `ValueError` is recorded as unreadable and refuses the entry. The rule is `behind(...) >= 0`, so a zero lean is allowed and a negative lean is refused. The condition is omitted when the option is off to preserve default signal output.

ORB and B2/B2M5 use M1 and M5 entries; the NY straddle enters from quotes and reads its context entry timeframe. None enters at H4 or above, so the gate was not forced onto an entry frame where no larger H4 frame exists. When enabled, each warmup requests at least 64 H4 bars (256 H1 bars, or 15,360 M1 bars).

## Gap 2: complete day plan

`DayPlan.check()` reads at most `READ_LIMIT` bytes, checks case-insensitive whole-word markers for condition, levels, the side with the edge, and scenarios, and returns a detail naming missing sections. `exists()` keeps its boolean API. The orchestrator passes the detailed check result into the DAY_PLAN gate. The AI markdown writer now emits an explicit `- scenarios:` marker, matching its `DayPlan.scenarios` field. Existing file, directory, empty, whitespace, unreadable, invalid UTF-8 and bounded-read refusals remain fail-closed.

The shared integration test plan and late-plan fixture now contain all four required sections. The API sample fixture includes the four new optional parameters with `false` defaults.

## Tests and mutations

Each mutant was planted against the production implementation, exercised by the named test, and restored by `plant_bugs_4.py`'s recovery journal and `finally` handler. The output is in `plant_bugs_4_output.txt`.

Mutation result: **8 caught, 0 missed**. The first mutation-runner attempt reported one missed NY mutation because it changed a redundant downstream check. That check was removed; the mutation was retargeted to the journal gate, and the final run caught all eight.

## Defaults and parity

All four new options default to `False`. Default strategy decisions do not add an edge condition, and warmups stay at their previous values when the option is off. Existing golden/parity tests passed in the first complete pytest run; no parity or golden-number files were edited. The API sample change only exposes the newly added optional fields as `false`.

+# DEV_SPEC_4 implementation notes
+
+## Gap 1: H4 edge rule on PLAN-1
+
+Added `require_edge_side: bool = False` to the ORB, NY straddle and B2 parameter models. Each enabled gate uses the existing `edge_lean()` and `behind()` functions, with the context's `entry_timeframe`. A missing reading or a `ValueError` is recorded as unreadable and refuses the entry. The rule is `behind(...) >= 0`, so a zero lean is allowed and a negative lean is refused. The condition is omitted when the option is off to preserve default signal output.
+
+ORB and B2/B2M5 use M1 and M5 entries; the NY straddle enters from quotes and reads its context entry timeframe. None enters at H4 or above, so the gate was not forced onto an entry frame where no larger H4 frame exists. When enabled, each warmup requests at least 64 H4 bars (256 H1 bars, or 15,360 M1 bars).
+
+## Gap 2: complete day plan
+
+`DayPlan.check()` reads at most `READ_LIMIT` bytes, checks case-insensitive whole-word markers for condition, levels, the side with the edge, and scenarios, and returns a detail naming missing sections. `exists()` keeps its boolean API. The orchestrator passes the detailed check result into the DAY_PLAN gate. The AI markdown writer now emits an explicit `- scenarios:` marker, matching its `DayPlan.scenarios` field. Existing file, directory, empty, whitespace, unreadable, invalid UTF-8 and bounded-read refusals remain fail-closed.
+
+The shared integration test plan and late-plan fixture now contain all four required sections. The API sample fixture includes the four new optional parameters with `false` defaults.
+
+## Tests and mutations
+
+Each mutant was planted against the production implementation, exercised by the named test, and restored by `plant_bugs_4.py`'s recovery journal and `finally` handler. The output is in `plant_bugs_4_output.txt`.
+

+def main() -> int:
+    restore()
+    originals: dict[str, bytes] = {}
+    for path, *_ in BUGS:
+        target = ROOT / path
+        originals[path] = target.read_bytes()
+    RECOVERY.mkdir(parents=True)
+    items = []
+    for index, (path, *_rest) in enumerate(BUGS):
+        backup = f"source_{index}.bin"
+        (RECOVERY / backup).write_bytes(originals[path])
+        items.append({"path": path, "backup": backup})
+    MANIFEST.write_text(json.dumps(items), encoding="utf-8")
+
+    lines = ["DEV_SPEC_4 planted-bug report", "Each mutant was restored before the next was planted.", ""]
+    try:
+        for path, before, after, test, label in BUGS:
+            target = ROOT / path
+            current = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+            if current.count(before) != 1:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"expected exactly one mutation site for {label} in {path}")
+            target.write_text(current.replace(before, after, 1), encoding="utf-8")
+            result = subprocess.run(
+                [sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", "-q", test],
+                cwd=ROOT,
+                capture_output=True,
+                text=True,
+                check=False,
+            )
+            restore()
+            # Recreate the recovery journal for the next mutant, with clean source bytes.
+            RECOVERY.mkdir(parents=True)
+            items = []
+            for index, (source, *_rest) in enumerate(BUGS):
+                backup = f"source_{index}.bin"
+                (RECOVERY / backup).write_bytes(originals[source])
+                items.append({"path": source, "backup": backup})
+            MANIFEST.write_text(json.dumps(items), encoding="utf-8")
+            status = "CAUGHT" if result.returncode else "MISSED"
+            summary = next(
+                (line.strip() for line in result.stdout.splitlines() if "failed" in line or "passed" in line),
+                "no pytest summary",
+            )
+            lines.append(f"{status}: {label} | {test} | {summary}")
+            OUTPUT.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+        restore()
+    finally:
+        restore()
+    missed = sum(line.startswith("MISSED:") for line in lines)
+    lines.extend(["", f"Caught: {len(BUGS) - missed}; missed: {missed}."])
+    OUTPUT.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    return int(missed > 0)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
